We deliver a variety of programs and services ranging from feature assessments to full feature deployments to support their growing and changing business needs within Workday.
  

  

At Workday, we help the world’s largest organizations adapt to what’s next by bringing finance, HR, and planning into a single enterprise cloud. We work hard, and we’re serious about what we do. But we like to have fun, too! We put people first, celebrate diversity, drive innovation, and prioritize giving back to our communities, demonstrating a commitment to corporate social responsibility. Our dedication to customer success, coupled with a vibrant and inclusive company culture, sets a strong foundation for continued growth and success at Workday.
**About the Role**

Would you enjoy learning new things in a fast paced environment? Do you have an appetite for variety and challenging business problems to solve? Are you a great communicator who can clearly articulate and demonstrate the value of Workday solutions to our customers? The Workday Success Plans team works directly with customers through targeted micro consulting engagements to help solve their business needs using the Workday application. Responsible for acting as a trusted Workday advisor, you will have the opportunity to assist customers with how\-to questions, troubleshoot and guide customers through configuration, and provide feature demonstrations. As a Workday expert, customers will benefit from your knowledge as you share your experience, identify key considerations, and highlight standard methodologies.


Our team of professionals have a broad and deep understanding of Workday, and enjoy the reward of helping customers solve problems, learn about new features, and find greater value in their Workday investment. So if you are passionate about the value technology can bring to an organization, love learning and want to work directly with some of the greatest companies on the planet, bring your energy and teamwork to the Workday Success Plans team!


Primary responsibilities of this role include delivering various services to Workday Success Plans customers. To be successful, this requires:


* Conducting research to ensure understanding of customer questions and related Workday concepts.
* Delivering small scope consulting in response to customer requests; providing configuration guidance, demonstrations, considerations, tips \& tricks.
* Troubleshooting product configuration to resolve or provide optimal product configuration to meet customer business requirements.
* Clearly and effectively communicating responses and value to customers.
* Creating and delivering customer presentations on how to use Workday features to achieve business goals (Accelerator Webinars).
* Providing one\-on\-one consulting guidance to accelerate customer feature adoption (Feature Accelerator).
* Reviewing customer tenants to identify adoption opportunities (Feature Adoption Tenant Reviews).
* Completing and maintaining product expertise and Workday Certification(s) along with familiarity with Workday roadmap.
* Keeping up to date with industry practices and the ability to engage with our customers on those topics.
* Helping drive the creation of new programs to drive customer feature adoption.

In addition to delivering Workday Success Plans services, our Workday professionals will also deliver other Customer Enablement services, such as:


* Office Hours to conduct appointment\-based consulting engagements providing guidance and product expertise to customers
* Perform configuration and business requirements reviews with a detailed deliverable calling out opportunities for optimization
* Provide one\-on\-one customer configuration designs
* Deployments including full deployment of Workday features
* Ability to travel up to 10%

**About You**

Basic Qualifications \- Senior Functional Consultant \- HCM and Security


* 10\+ years of Human Capital Management software and consulting experience on medium or large enterprise HRIS projects, or applicable practitioner deployment experience
* 10\+ years of experience with the following product areas: HCM and Security
* 8\+ years of Workday Consulting experience or experience as a Workday SME

  

Other Qualifications


* Demonstrates a solid grasp of HR related systems and processes. Able to gain a detailed understanding of Workday concepts and new feature releases in Core HCM, areas of expertise and cross application features.
* Certified or ability to certify in Workday HCM Products and to effectively deploy the solutions
* Experience with influencing, interacting and collaborating with senior leaders, internally and externally
* Capable of leading and influencing design meetings toward an effective and collaborative outcome
* Ability to deliver and get results while managing to a project plan
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience with global implementations is preferred.
* The ability to work on multiple engagements simultaneously.
* Strong critical thinking skills so as to understand complex, technical process issues and facilitate/influence decision making
* Bachelor’s degree or related experience required
* Ability to travel up to 10%

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. description:
**Job Description**

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI\-led, platform\-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry\-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654\.4M FY26 revenue with 17\.4% Y\-o\-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436\.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3\.2% Q\-o\-Q and 16\.2% Y\-o\-Y growth. Our 27,500\+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026\.

 **About Position:**

  

We are seeking a skilled Workday HCM Specialist to join our dynamic team in Pune, India. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in configuring, maintaining, and optimizing Workday HCM business processes and integrations. This role is critical in ensuring the efficiency and reliability of our Human Capital Management operations.

* **Role: Workday HCM Specialist**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 5 to 8 Years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**

 **What You'll Do:**

  

* Configure, maintain, and optimize Workday HCM business processes, organizational structures, security roles, and workforce management functionalities.
* Support Workday modules including Core HCM, Payroll, Benefits, Compensation, and Talent Management.
* Develop, maintain, and enhance Workday reports, dashboards, scorecards, and data extracts to meet business and compliance requirements.
* Manage and support integrations between Workday, ADP, benefits providers, identity management platforms, and other enterprise applications.
* Collaborate with HR, Payroll, Benefits, Finance, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and implement system improvements.
* Troubleshoot and resolve Workday functional and integration\-related issues in a timely manner.
* Perform data validation, testing, and quality assurance activities for system enhancements, upgrades, and releases.
* Support Workday security administration, user access management, and compliance requirements.
* Create and maintain technical and functional documentation, process flows, and user guides.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance system efficiency, automation, and user experience.
* Participate in Workday release management activities, evaluating new features and recommending adoption where appropriate.
* Ensure data integrity, accuracy, and compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.

 **Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 5 to 8 years of experience working with Workday HCM implementations, support, and enhancements.
* Strong expertise in Workday Core HCM configuration and business process management.
* Hands\-on experience with Payroll and Benefits administration within Workday environments.
* Experience developing Workday reports, dashboards, calculated fields, and custom data extracts.
* Strong knowledge of Workday security, organizational structures, and workforce administration.
* Experience managing and troubleshooting Workday integrations using EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, and Web Services.
* Ability to analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable Workday solutions.
* Knowledge of HR operations, employee lifecycle management, payroll processing, and benefits programs.

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies

title: Founder's Office Intern
description:
**About Pavo Ads**

We are building a forward\-thinking AdTech platform revolutionizing digital advertising for modern brands. By utilizing advanced technology, data\-driven insights, and impactful media formats, we excel at creating meaningful brand\-consumer connections. Our mission is to redefine advertising through innovation, creativity, and strategic media placement. At Pavo Ads, we empower brands to amplify their reach, engage audiences effectively, and leave lasting impressions in the digital age.

**About the Role**

This is not a regular internship. As part of the Founder's Office, you will work directly with the CEO on day\-to\-day operations, business development, hiring, and strategy. No two days will be the same one day you're running a hiring round, the next you're building a pitch deck or managing social media. If you want to learn how a startup actually runs from the inside, this is the role.

**What You'll Do**

**Operations \& Coordination**

* Assist the Founder in day\-to\-day business operations and execution
* Track tasks, follow up on pending items, and ensure things don't fall through the cracks
* Coordinate between different vendors, candidates, and partners on behalf of the Founder

**Digital Marketing**

* Manage Pavo Ads' social media presence — Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook
* Create and schedule content using Canva
* Assist in GMB management, website updates, and SEO activities
* Track analytics and share weekly performance reports

**Hiring \& HR Support**

* Post job openings on various portals — Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, Apna
* Screen resumes, schedule interviews, and coordinate with candidates
* Draft offer letters, rejection mails, and onboarding communications

**Research \& Business Development**

* Conduct market research — competitors, pricing, industry trends
* Identify potential retail partners and brand clients for outreach
* Prepare reports, presentations, and data summaries as required

**Miscellaneous**

* Whatever the business needs — you figure it out and get it done

**Who We're Looking For**

✅ Fresher or up to 1 year of experience — any background welcome  
✅ Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English  
✅ Comfortable with MS Office / Google Workspace  
✅ Basic knowledge of Canva and social media platforms  
✅ Self\-starter who doesn't wait to be told what to do next  
✅ Curious, organised, and comfortable with ambiguity  
✅ Available full\-time from our Preet Vihar, Delhi office (Hybrid)

**What You Get**

\- Stipend: ₹8,000 – ₹12,000 per month (based on skills)  
\- Direct mentorship from the Founder \& CEO  
\- Real exposure to how a startup is built from scratch  
\- Certificate \+ Letter of Recommendation on completion  
\- Pre\-placement opportunity based on performance

**Duration:** 3–6 Months  
**Location:** Preet Vihar, Delhi (Hybrid)  
**Joining:** Immediate

**How to Apply**

**Location:** Noida

**Reports To:** HR Manager / dotted line reporting to Head of Quality (QMS)

**Job Purpose**

The Training \& Development Lead is responsible for designing, implementing, and governing an end\-to\-end employee learning framework using the ADDIE model. This role bridges general HR/organizational development and technical competency mapping, ensuring all training processes comply with **ISO 9001:2015 (Clause 7\.2 \- Competence)** standards.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**

**1\. End\-to\-End Training Management (ADDIE Model)**

· **Analysis:** Conduct organization\-wide Training Needs Analysis (TNA) across general, HR, soft\-skills, and technical product/process domains.

· **Design \& Development:** Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to build structured training modules, SOPs, and On\-the\-Job Training (OJT) frameworks.

· **Implementation:** Schedule, coordinate, and facilitate both internal technical deep\-dives and external certification programs.

· **Evaluation:** Measure training effectiveness post\-30/60 days via performance data, manager sign\-offs, and skill evaluations.

**2\. QMS \& ISO 9001 Governance**

· Maintain and update the organization’s **Training SOP** and centralized QMS documentation.

· Maintain auditor\-ready records, including Skills Matrices, signed attendance logs, training plans, and effectiveness sign\-offs.

· Lead internal and external audit readiness for Clause 7\.2 (Competence, Training, and Awareness).

**3\. Technical \& Operational Competency Mapping**

· Partner with engineering, firmware, hardware, and assembly leads to map technical roles to required skill levels.

· Formalize peer review mechanisms, OJT sign\-offs, and high\-voltage/lab safety training logs.

**4\. Metrics \& Reporting**

· Track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Training Completion Rate (\>90%), Training Effectiveness Rate (\>85%), and Skill Gap Reduction.

· Present quarterly training metrics and compliance reports to management during Management Review Meetings (MRM).

**Qualifications \& Key Requirements**

· **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

They are as comfortable building frameworks as they are getting things done.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





***Strategy and Planning***



* Lead the development and maintenance of organisational strategy, ensuring clarity on direction, priorities, and resource allocation.
* Support senior leadership in designing and executing key strategic initiatives across Impact Beacon's advisory practice.
* Conduct research, market analysis, and landscape scans to inform strategic decisions and identify new opportunities.
* Prepare strategic briefs, position papers, and decision\-support materials that allow leadership to move with speed and confidence.



  





***Organisational Building***



* Build and maintain systems and processes that allow the organisation to operate effectively as it scales.
* Drive internal capability building, including onboarding frameworks, knowledge management, and performance systems.
* Identify and resolve structural or process gaps that limit organisational effectiveness.



  





***Innovation and New Initiatives***



* Lead the development of new offerings, market extensions, or strategic partnerships from concept through viability assessment and launch.
* Monitor the external landscape for trends, adjacent opportunities, and emerging client needs that Impact Beacon should respond to.
* Translate strategic ideas into structured briefs and execution\-ready plans.



  





***Client Engagement and Advisory Support***



* Lead or support client\-facing conversations, including discovery calls, engagement reviews, and senior stakeholder meetings.
* Represent Impact Beacon with clarity and credibility in conversations with Executive Directors, boards, and leadership teams of nonprofit organisations.
* Contribute to proposal development, client scoping, and advisory output at a standard that reflects the firm's quality bar.
* Build relationships with clients and partners that reinforce Impact Beacon's position as a trusted strategic partner.



  





***Execution and Coordination***



* Ensure continuity and follow\-through across strategic priorities, tracking decisions, dependencies, and outcomes.
* Maintain situational awareness across all active initiatives and surface risks or misalignments early.
* Serve as a coordination anchor across internal teams and external partners where required.



  





**Role Expectations** 





 This role requires a high degree of ownership, intellectual rigour, and the ability to operate without a clear playbook. The successful candidate will be as comfortable building a strategy framework as they are leading a client conversation or developing a new service offering. They will take initiative, exercise good judgment, and bring structure to ambiguity.
 




  






 Impact Beacon works closely with nonprofit leaders who are navigating real operational and strategic pressure. The person in this role must understand that world, not from the outside, but from direct exposure to how these organisations are built and how they function across departments.
 




  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* 5 to 8 years of experience in strategy, consulting, organisational development, or a combination of these.
* Direct experience working in or with nonprofit organisations. This is a must\-have, not a nice\-to\-have.
* Working knowledge of how multiple departments within a nonprofit function, including fundraising, finance, programs, HR, and governance.
* Proven ability to lead or contribute to client\-facing conversations at a senior level, with clarity and confidence.
* Strong analytical and structured thinking skills, with the ability to move from insight to action.
* Excellent written communication, clear, precise, and capable of tailoring to different audiences.
* Experience designing or contributing to organisational structures, systems, or people strategies.
* Ability to develop new ideas into well\-structured, viable initiatives.
* High degree of ownership and follow\-through, comfortable working independently on complex problems.
* Comfort operating in ambiguous environments where priorities shift and clarity must be created, not inherited.



  





**Who Will Thrive Here** 





 You will thrive in this role if you are energised by building things, not just improving them. You think at the level of the organisation, not just the task in front of you. You are comfortable moving between high\-level strategy and ground\-level execution. You understand how nonprofits work from the inside, the pressures their leaders face, the constraints they operate within, and what it actually takes to help them move. You can hold a room with a client and hold a complex strategic workstream at the same time. Leadership can hand you a half\-formed problem and trust that something clear, considered, and actionable will come back.
 




  





**Growth Opportunity** 



* Direct exposure to senior leadership decision\-making across strategy, growth, and organisational design.
* Ownership of high\-impact initiatives at a pivotal stage of the firm's growth.
* Exposure to advisory work across a growing portfolio of nonprofit and social impact clients globally.
* Opportunity to shape Impact Beacon's future offerings, market position, and internal architecture.





 ﻿
 





**About Impact Beacon** 





 Impact Beacon is a strategic knowledge partner that mission\-driven organisations rely on to succeed. We combine deep nonprofit understanding with data\-driven tools and systems to turn potential impact into measurable results. We help organisations strengthen critical but non\-core functions so they can focus on their mission. Our solutions span Donor Lifecycle and Community Management, People, Culture and Talent Systems, Governance and Financial Systems, and Operational Continuity and Internal Systems.

description:
**About Us**
============


Ready to rock the future with us? At Hellmann we put our people at the heart of everything we do, because for us, relationship matters. Joining us does not just mean becoming part of a global company. It is an invitation to shape the future of the logistics industry together with us. Our Hellmann culture is based on our four values: Caring, Entrepreneurial, Forward\-Thinking and Reliable. These values resonate with yours? Then become part of our FAMILY that consists of around 10\.000 employees in more than 200 locations worldwide.  

For the better. Together.

  


Are you ready to take the next step in your career? As a Global Talent and Organization Development Senior (m/f/d) at Hellmann Worldwide Logistics, you will play a key role in shaping our global HR landscape. This position offers a unique opportunity to be part of an exciting HR transformation journey—where you take ownership, drive innovation, and collaborate with a team of passionate professionals. **About the job**


Learning strategy and capability building

* Develop and deliver a global learning and capability\-building strategy aligned with business priorities and our people strategy.

* Build capability frameworks and learning roadmaps that support organizational growth and transformation.

Learning design and development

* Design, develop and continuously improve learning solutions for classroom, virtual, hybrid and self\-paced digital formats.

Talent and leadership development

* Design and manage global talent and leadership development programs, including offers for emerging leaders, high potentials and critical talent groups.
* Build career development pathways and learning journeys that support career growth and internal mobility.
* Partner with stakeholders on succession\-related development and targeted capability building.
* Support onboarding, upskilling and reskilling as part of an integrated talent approach.


Organizational development

* Contribute to organizational development work such as capability modeling, role architecture and organizational effectiveness.
* Support the design of career frameworks and organizational capability assessments.
* Bring a learning lens to change and transformation initiatives.


Learning technology and measurement

* Work with our HRIS and technology teams to make the most of our learning management system and other learning technologies.
* Manage learning content deployment, learner experience, reporting and analytics.
* Measure learning effectiveness through data, feedback and business impact, and act on what you find.
* Track external trends and emerging technologies to keep our learning ecosystem current.

**About you**


Must\-have

* At least five years of experience in learning and development, talent development, instructional design or a related field.
* Experience designing and delivering global learning and talent programs in a multinational organization.
* A track record of building learning solutions across classroom, virtual, hybrid and digital channels.
* Experience designing leadership development or talent acceleration programs.
* Experience building learning journeys, development pathways or career frameworks.

* Excellent communication and storytelling, strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, and a global, intercultural mindset.

Nice\-to\-have

* Certification in instructional design, learning experience design, adult learning, facilitation, coaching or leadership development.
* Familiarity with learning analytics and evaluation frameworks such as Kirkpatrick.
* Experience with AI\-enabled learning solutions and adaptive learning platforms.
* Experience developing large\-scale global leadership academies or enterprise reskilling initiatives.
* Knowledge of organizational design, workforce planning or change management methodologies.
* Familiarity with skills\-based talent management and career architecture frameworks.
* Additional language skills beyond English.

**How you work**


We are looking for someone whose way of working reflects our values:

* Caring. You build trusted relationships, listen well and keep learners and colleagues at the center of what you design.
* Entrepreneurial. You take ownership, show initiative and stay focused on the impact your work has on the business.
* Forward\-Thinking. You bring curiosity and a digital mindset, and you keep improving how we learn and develop.
* Reliable. You deliver quality work on time, follow through on commitments and measure whether it worked.


Inclusion and social diversity are firmly anchored values in our corporate culture. Regardless of gender, age, any disabilities, religion, ethnic origin or sexual identity: We are looking forward to meeting you!


If you are excited by this fantastic opportunity and have what it takes, then click APPLY!

title: HR Operations Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – HR OPERATIONS MANAGER

**Department:** Human Resources  
**Location:** Mumbai  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years  
**Qualification:** MBA / PGDM – HR or equivalent  
**Reporting To:** Head HR / Senior Management

Job Purpose

The **HR Operations Manager** will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end HR Operations across clinics and central teams, ensuring smooth employee lifecycle management, policy implementation, employee relations, payroll coordination, HRMS management, compliance and a strong employee culture.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. HR Operations**

* Manage day\-to\-day HR Operations across all locations.
* Handle complete employee lifecycle from joining to exit.
* Manage onboarding, confirmation, transfers, promotions and exit formalities.
* Maintain employee records, documentation and HR trackers.
* Ensure HR processes and SOPs are followed consistently.

**2\. Attendance \& Leave Management**

* Manage attendance, leave, regularisation, permissions and absenteeism.
* Monitor late coming and attendance\-related issues.
* Coordinate with managers for attendance corrections and approvals.
* Ensure timely attendance closure for payroll.

**3\. Payroll Operations**

* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs with Finance/Payroll.
* Verify LOP, overtime, incentives, deductions and salary changes.
* Ensure accurate and timely payroll inputs.
* Handle employee salary and payroll\-related queries.

**4\. HRMS Management**

* Manage HRMS employee data and records.
* Monitor attendance, leave and regularisation processes.
* Ensure accurate and updated HRMS records.
* Coordinate with HRMS vendors for system\-related issues.

**5\. Employee Relations**

* Handle employee queries, grievances and workplace concerns.
* Support managers in handling employee\-related issues.
* Manage warnings, disciplinary actions and employee documentation wherever required.
* Maintain confidentiality and ensure professional resolution of concerns.

**6\. Employee Engagement \& Culture Building**

* Build and maintain a positive and people\-focused work culture.
* Plan and execute regular **employee engagement activities**.
* Organise **team\-building activities, celebrations and recognition initiatives**.
* Drive employee connect initiatives across clinics and central teams.
* Focus on employee morale, collaboration, belonging and retention.

**8\. Performance Management**

* Coordinate the overall performance and appraisal process and ensure timely completion.

Required Skills

* 5–8 years of experience in **HR Operations**.
* Strong knowledge of HR Operations, attendance and payroll.
* Experience with HRMS; **GreytHR preferred**.
* Good knowledge of HR policies and labour compliance.
* Strong employee relations and grievance\-handling skills.
* Strong employee engagement and culture\-building skills.
* Good Excel / Google Sheets skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Strong follow\-up, problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to independently manage HR Operations across multiple locations.

Preferred Experience

Experience in **Healthcare, Hospitals, Clinics, Retail, Hospitality or other multi\-location organisations** will be preferred.

Ideal Candidate

A **hands\-on, proactive and people\-oriented HR professional** who can independently manage HR Operations, maintain process discipline, resolve employee concerns and build a positive, engaging and collaborative workplace culture.

The role will be accountable for building a scalable, productive, performance-driven and future-ready organization by strengthening organization design, manpower productivity, talent acquisition, performance management, capability building, succession, employee relations, HR governance and people analytics. The DGM – HR is expected to operate as a business HR leader, moving HR from predominantly transactional support to a function that measurably contributes to business growth, productivity, leadership capability and organizational effectiveness. 2. Key Accountabilities A. Strategic HR Business Partnership Partner with the GM Operation & HR and business leadership to translate business plans into people, organization and capability priorities. Develop annual and 3-year HR plans for JAPL, JSPL and JMPL aligned with growth, capacity, productivity and organizational requirements. Advise leadership on organization structure, manpower, capability, performance, talent and people risks. Build a consistent HR operating model across the three businesses while allowing appropriate business-specific flexibility. Participate in business reviews and ensure people-related actions have clear ownership and closure. B. Organization Design & Manpower Productivity Drive organization structure reviews across businesses/functions. Establish approved manpower norms and budgets linked to production volume, capacity and business plans. 2 Review spans, layers, role clarity and reporting relationships. Drive workforce optimization without compromising safety, quality or delivery. Track manpower productivity, overtime, absenteeism, contract labour utilization and employee cost. Establish clear role charters and accountability across critical positions. Key outcome: Right structure Right manpower Right capability Right cost. C. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Pipeline Own workforce planning and recruitment governance across JAPL, JSPL and JMPL. Ensure timely closure of leadership, managerial, technical and critical shop-floor positions. Build sustainable pipelines through ITI/Diploma institutions, engineering colleges, apprenticeships, trainees, referrals and specialist hiring channels. Strengthen selection quality, onboarding and early-tenure retention. Build succession-oriented internal hiring and career mobility before external recruitment. D. Performance & Accountability Culture Institutionalize a robust Performance Management System across businesses. Ensure goals cascade from: Business Function Department Individual. Strengthen measurable KRAs/KPIs and differentiate performance objectively. Facilitate performance reviews, calibration and consequence management. Link performance with business outcomes such as productivity, quality, delivery, cost, projects, capability and people development. Build stronger managerial accountability for team performance. E. Talent Management, Succession & Leadership Pipeline Identify critical roles and critical talent across all three businesses. Establish succession coverage for key leadership and specialist positions. Conduct structured talent reviews and identify HiPos. Establish Ready Now / Ready in 1–2 Years / Longer-term succession categories. Drive Individual Development Plans for critical talent. Strengthen internal mobility and cross-functional/business exposure. Reduce dependency on individual incumbents and external hiring for key positions. F. Learning, Capability & Skill Architecture Build capability architecture covering operators, technicians, engineers, managers and leadership levels. Establish functional/technical competency matrices. Drive multi-skilling and skill certification for shop-floor workforce. Build structured development journeys for supervisors and managers. 3 Use the 70:20:10 development philosophy for identified leadership talent. Measure training through capability improvement and business impact rather than training hours alone. G. Industrial / Employee Relations & Workforce Governance Maintain a stable, disciplined and productive employee-relations environment across the businesses. Establish robust grievance and disciplinary processes. Ensure appropriate handling of domestic enquiries and employee-relations matters. Govern permanent, trainee, apprentice and contract workforce practices. Partner with operations leadership to proactively address workforce risks. Strengthen employee communication and shop-floor connect mechanisms. H. Statutory Compliance & HR Governance Ensure compliance with applicable labour and employment legislation and factory-related people requirements. Establish compliance calendars and periodic audits across JAPL, JSPL and JMPL. Govern contractor compliance and documentation. Ensure timely closure of audit observations and statutory deviations. Coordinate with legal counsel and government/labour authorities where required. Maintain zero tolerance for material people-related statutory non-compliance. I. Employee Engagement, Culture & Change Build a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, performance and continuous improvement. Strengthen communication between leadership, managers and employees. Drive structured employee-engagement interventions based on data and business needs. Support organizational transformation, restructuring, digitalization and new ways of working. Build change readiness among managers and employees. Actively identify and address behaviours that impede organizational change. J. HR Operations, Systems & Analytics Standardize critical HR processes across the three businesses. Drive HRMS/digital adoption and improve employee/manager self-service. Establish a monthly HR Business Dashboard for the GM Operation& HR Use workforce analytics for decision-making rather than retrospective reporting. Ensure employee master data, attendance, payroll inputs, lifecycle transactions and documentation are accurate and controlled. 4 3. Key Performance Indicators Dimension Illustrative KPI Manpower Actual manpower vs approved manpower/budget Productivity Revenue/value-add/output per employee Employee Cost Employee cost vs budget / revenue Recruitment Critical vacancy closure TAT Attrition Regrettable/critical talent attrition Attendance Absenteeism & overtime Capability Critical skill coverage / multi-skilling Performance PMS completion & quality of goal setting Succession % critical roles with identified successors Talent HiPo/critical talent retention & development Engagement Engagement/change-readiness improvement IR Lost man-days / significant grievances / disputes Compliance Statutory compliance & audit closure HR Operations HRMS/data/process accuracy Leadership Internal fill rate for critical managerial roles 4. Decision Rights Recommend organization structures and manpower plans to the COO. Challenge manpower additions not supported by productivity/business justification. Approve routine HR decisions within delegated authority. Drive HR policy and process implementation across JAPL, JSPL and JMPL. Intervene in significant performance, discipline, talent and employee-relations matters. Recommend promotions, succession moves, critical hiring and organization changes. Escalate material, people, IR, compliance and leadership risks directly to the COO. 5 5. People Judgement – strong ability to assess talent, performance and potential. Change Leadership – able to drive behavioural, structural and process change. description:
HR Director, India & Global Capability Centre Location: Bangalore, Karnataka, India
 Department: People and Talent
 Reports to: Chief People Officer (UK based)
 Direct Reports: HR Manager and wider HR team of professionals Role Overview We are seeking an experienced HR Director to provide strategic and operational leadership for our Bangalore office and Global Capability Centre. This is a senior leadership role responsible for building and leading the India people function, with the HR Manager reporting into this post and a wider HR team of four professionals supporting delivery across recruitment, HR operations, compliance, payroll governance, employee relations, engagement and people experience. The HR Director will partner closely with the UK-based Chief People Officer to develop a more strategic and globally consistent people agenda. The role will translate global people priorities into the local India context, ensuring the Bangalore GCC can scale effectively while supporting the companys ambition to grow from a UK-headquartered start-up into a global business. Key Responsibilities 1. HR Leadership, Team Management & Functional Strategy Lead the India People function as the senior HR leader for the Bangalore GCC, setting the direction, priorities and operating rhythm for the local HR team. Line manage the HR Manager, ensuring they are developed beyond operational delivery into a more strategic HR leadership role. Oversee a wider HR team of four professionals, ensuring effective delivery across talent acquisition, HR operations, compliance, employee relations, payroll governance, reporting and employee experience. Build capability within the HR team through coaching, mentoring, clear accountability, succession planning and exposure to strategic people projects. Ensure the HR function operates as a proactive, commercially minded and trusted partner to employees, managers, India leadership and the UK head office. 2. India HR Governance, Operations & Compliance Ensure full compliance with Indian labour laws and statutory regulations including: Shops & Establishments Act (Karnataka) Payment of Wages Act Minimum Wages Act Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF) Employees’ State Insurance (ESI) Payment of Bonus Act Payment of Gratuity Act Maternity Benefit Act Equal Remuneration Act POSH Act (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) Labour Welfare Fund (LWF) Maintain statutory registers, filings, and documentation. Coordinate with legal advisors and external consultants where required. Lead internal audits and prepare for labour inspections. Oversee employment contracts and policy documentation aligned with Indian legal standards. Provide senior oversight of India HR risk, ensuring local statutory requirements are met while maintaining alignment with UK head office governance standards. 3. Talent Strategy, Workforce Planning & GCC Growth Own the India talent strategy for the Bangalore GCC, ensuring hiring plans support current delivery requirements and future global growth. Partner with India leadership and the UK CPO to translate business strategy into workforce plans, organisational design and capability priorities. Ensure compliant, competitive and scalable recruitment processes, offer governance and employment documentation for the Indian market. Strengthen employer brand and talent attraction in Bangalore, positioning the company as an ambitious UK-headquartered global business. Support the set-up and growth of the Bangalore operation, ensuring hiring activity is compliant with healthcare, technology and local market requirements. Develop scalable workforce planning approaches that balance start-up pace, cost discipline, quality of talent, compliance and long-term global capability building. 4. Reward, Payroll & Compensation Governance Oversee payroll processing in compliance with Indian statutory requirements. Ensure timely EPF, ESI, TDS, and professional tax deductions and filings. Administer gratuity, bonus calculations, and leave encashments. Support CTC structuring aligned with Indian taxation norms. Work with the UK CPO to develop reward principles that are locally competitive in India while supporting the company’s broader global reward philosophy. 5. Employee Relations, Culture & Performance Provide senior oversight and escalation for complex employee relations matters, ensuring issues are resolved fairly, consistently and in line with Indian labour law. description:
POSITION DETAILS Position: HR Executive Department: Human Resources Location: Ahmedabad Employment Type: Full-Time Work Mode: Work From Office Experience: 13 Years Reporting To: HR Manager 
 ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a proactive and people-oriented HR Executive to join our Human Resources team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for supporting end-to-end recruitment, HR operations, employee engagement, onboarding, employee records, and day-to-day HR activities .The candidate should have strong communication and coordination skills, a positive attitude, attention to detail, and the ability to handle multiple HR activities simultaneously in a fast-paced IT environment. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. RECRUITMENT & TALENT ACQUISITION Manage end-to-end recruitment for technical and non-technical positions. Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, employee referrals, and other recruitment channels . Screen resumes based on job requirements and organizational needs. Conduct initial HR screening calls and candidate assessments . Coordinate technical, managerial, and HR interviews with candidates and hiring managers. Maintain regular communication and follow-ups with candidates throughout the hiring process. Coordinate offer discussions, documentation, and joining formalities. Follow up with selected candidates to ensure successful joining. Maintain recruitment trackers, ATS, candidate databases, and hiring reports. Prepare regular recruitment status and hiring reports. Build and maintain a healthy candidate pipeline for current and future requirements. Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process. 2. HR OPERATIONS Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records and HR documentation . Manage employee onboarding and exit formalities. Coordinate employee attendance and leave-related activities. Maintain and update employee information in Keka HRMS . Handle day-to-day employee queries and provide appropriate HR support. Support employee confirmation and appraisal processes. Maintain HR policies, processes, forms, and related documentation. Ensure proper documentation and record-keeping for HR activities. Support the HR Manager in implementing and improving HR processes. Coordinate with employees and internal departments for various HR requirements. Maintain confidentiality of employee information and HR-related documents. 3. ONBOARDING & EXIT MANAGEMENT Coordinate the complete employee onboarding process. Ensure timely completion of joining documentation and required formalities. Coordinate with IT/Admin teams for system, workstation, access, and other joining requirements. Conduct or coordinate HR induction for new employees. Ensure new employees are introduced to company policies, processes, and culture. Coordinate employee exit formalities, documentation, and clearance processes. Conduct exit discussions/interviews where required. Maintain accurate onboarding and exit records. 4. EMPLOYEE ENGAGEMENT & CULTURE Plan and coordinate employee engagement activities throughout the year. Organize Fun Fridays, team-building activities, games, celebrations, and employee activities . Plan and coordinate Employee of the Month (EOM) activities and recognition programs. Coordinate employee birthday celebrations and special occasions. Plan and decorate the office for festivals and celebrations. Coordinate annual events, picnics, outings, celebrations, and other employee programs. Collect employee feedback and identify opportunities to improve employee experience. Suggest and implement new engagement initiatives based on employee feedback. Work closely with employees to promote a positive and collaborative workplace culture. 5. EVENT & VENDOR COORDINATION Coordinate with external vendors for HR and employee engagement activities. Manage vendors for food, gifts, decorations, event arrangements, venues, and other requirements . Obtain quotations and coordinate with vendors as required. Ensure events and activities are executed smoothly and within approved budgets. Coordinate logistics and arrangements for company events and celebrations. Maintain records of vendors, quotations, bills, and event-related expenses. 6. HR REPORTING & DOCUMENTATION Maintain accurate HR trackers and reports. Prepare recruitment and employee-related reports as required. Maintain employee databases and HR documentation. Track recruitment status, joining status, attrition, attendance, and other HR metrics. Ensure timely updating of HRMS and internal HR records. Support the HR Manager with HR data and reports for management review. 
 REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field . 1-3 years of relevant HR experience, preferably in an IT/software organization . Good understanding of recruitment and HR operations. Experience in technical recruitment will be an added advantage. Hands-on experience with recruitment portals such as Naukri and LinkedIn . Experience working with HRMS/ATS systems; knowledge of Keka is preferred. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Good interpersonal and relationship-building skills. Strong coordination and follow-up skills. Good organizational and time-management abilities. Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously. Strong attention to detail and documentation skills. Proactive, approachable, and positive attitude. Ability to maintain confidentiality of employee and company information. 
 KEY COMPETENCIES Recruitment & Talent Acquisition HR Operations Employee Relations Employee Engagement Communication Skills Stakeholder Coordination Vendor Management Event Management Problem Solving Time Management Documentation & Reporting Team Collaboration

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working independently while also collaborating with employees, managers, vendors, and other departments.The HR Executive will play an important role in supporting both business hiring requirements and employee experience while ensuring smooth execution of day-to-day HR processes.

 About LLM Axis 
 LLM Axis Private Limited is an AI education and workforce development company focused on helping international students and working professionals become AI-ready for the evolving global job market. We are building one of India's fastest-growing AI upskilling brands through practical learning, mentorship, industry-aligned curriculum, and outcome-driven training. 
 As we scale our sales operations, we're looking for a Talent Acquisition professional who can help us identify, attract, and hire high-performing EdTech sales talent. 
 Role Overview 
 As a Human Resource Generalist at LLM Axis , you will be responsible for managing the end-to-end recruitment process, with a primary focus on hiring Sales and Business Development professionals. 
 We are specifically looking for someone who understands the dynamics of EdTech hiring and can independently source, screen and close candidates.

 Own the end-to-end recruitment cycle from sourcing to candidate joining. Primarily hire for Business Development, Inside Sales and other revenue-focused roles. Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, Apna, referrals and other relevant platforms. Conduct initial screening calls and evaluate candidates based on communication, sales experience, stability, compensation and role fit. Schedule and coordinate interviews with founders and respective hiring managers. Manage salary discussions, offer rollouts, documentation and joining coordination. Follow up actively with offered candidates to minimize offer dropouts and no-shows. Build and maintain an active pipeline of qualified sales candidates for upcoming requirements. Maintain accurate recruitment trackers and candidate databases. Track key recruitment metrics including sourcing volume, interviews, selections, offers and joining ratios. Good understanding of the EdTech sales talent market. Strong sourcing experience using platforms such as Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed and Apna. Ability to independently conduct initial HR and candidate screening. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Good negotiation and candidate-closing abilities. Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with hiring targets. Strong follow-up and coordination skills. Working knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets and recruitment trackers or ATS platforms. Candidates with an existing network of EdTech sales professionals will have an advantage.

On behalf of ASL, iEmpower Leaders is hiring an Accounts Payable & Payment Process Executive to be based in Ahmedabad, India. This role will support end-to-end vendor invoice processing, payment execution and reconciliation within ASL's finance/shared-services function, ensuring accuracy, compliance and timeliness across the AP cycle. 
 Key Details Job Title Accounts Payable & Payment Process Executive Client ASL Aviation Holdings Location Ahmedabad, India (Work from Office) Department Finance & Accounts / Shared Services Employment Type Full-Time, Permanent Experience 2-6 years in Accounts Payable / Payment Processing 
 Key Responsibilities Process vendor invoices end-to-end verification, three-way matching (PO, GRN, invoice), coding and posting in the ERP/accounting system. Execute payment runs (bank transfers, wire payments, cheques) in line with approved payment schedules and vendor terms. Reconcile vendor statements and the AP sub-ledger against the general ledger; investigate and resolve discrepancies. Track invoice ageing and ensure payments are released within agreed SLAs and payment terms. Respond to vendor queries on invoice status, payment status and outstanding balances in a timely, professional manner. Maintain accurate records of invoices, approvals, and supporting documentation for audit readiness. Support month-end close activities including AP accruals, provisions and expense cut-off. Ensure compliance with internal controls, approval matrices, and statutory requirements (e.g., TDS, GST as applicable). Coordinate with procurement, operations and other regional/group finance teams to resolve invoice or PO mismatches. Assist with vendor master data setup and periodic vendor reconciliations. Prepare periodic AP reports/dashboards (ageing, payment status, accruals) for finance leadership. Support internal and external audit requirements by providing documentation and clarifications as needed. 
 Required Skills & Competencies Strong working knowledge of accounts payable processes: invoice processing, three-way matching, payment runs and vendor reconciliation. Good understanding of basic taxation concepts relevant to vendor payments (TDS/GST or equivalent). Proficiency in MS Excel for reconciliations, reporting and data analysis. Strong attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry and reconciliation. Good communication skills to liaise with vendors and cross-functional/international teams (given ASL's global operations). Ability to work within defined SLAs and manage multiple invoices/payment cycles simultaneously. Experience working in a shared-services, GBS, or outsourced finance environment is an advantage. Prior exposure to a multinational or aviation/logistics industry environment is a plus, though not mandatory. 
 Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related field (B.Com/BBA/M.Com or equivalent); CA or Semi-Qualified CA candidates are also welcome to apply. 2-6 years of relevant experience in Accounts Payable, Payment Processing, or General Accounting roles. NAMTECH is committed to bridging the gap between academia and industry by preparing students for successful careers through structured placement processes, strong corporate partnerships, and skill development initiatives.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager - Placements to lead end-to-end student placement operations, corporate relationship management, and career services at NAMTECH. ¢ Strong analytical skills for placement data tracking and reporting.
¢ Team leadership and cross-functional collaboration skills.

 Key Responsibilities 
 1. HR Operations Payroll Management Manage and coordinate the complete monthly payroll process in collaboration with Finance and relevant stakeholders. Ensure accurate collection and validation of attendance, leave, salary revisions, incentives, reimbursements, deductions, and other payroll-related inputs. Coordinate with payroll vendors, Finance, and internal teams to ensure timely and accurate salary processing. Address employee queries related to salary, deductions, reimbursements, and payroll. Ensure payroll records and documentation are maintained accurately and confidentially. Support statutory and compliance-related payroll requirements. 
 HRIS & HRMS Management Manage and maintain employee data on the organization's HRIS/HRMS platform . Ensure accurate employee information, including onboarding details, employee records, reporting structures, attendance, leave, and other HR data. Coordinate with HRMS/HRIS vendors for system-related issues, enhancements, and process improvements. Monitor data accuracy and ensure regular audits of HRMS records. Support implementation of new HR modules, processes, and automation initiatives. Generate HR reports and dashboards from the HRMS as required by management. Train and support employees and managers in using HRMS systems and processes. 
 Employee Lifecycle Management Oversee HR operational activities across the employee lifecycle, including: Joining and onboarding documentation Employee data management Confirmation processes Transfers and internal movements Salary revisions and promotions Employee exits and separation documentation Ensure all employee records and HR documentation are updated accurately and maintained as per company policies. 
 HR Operations & Process Improvement Develop, implement, and continuously improve HR operational processes and SOPs. Identify opportunities for automation and process efficiency. Ensure timely completion of HR operational activities and adherence to defined timelines. Support HR audits and provide necessary documentation and reports. Maintain confidentiality and ensure proper handling of employee information. 
 2. Administration & Vendor Management Administrative Operations Oversee day-to-day administrative operations to ensure smooth functioning of the office. Coordinate with internal teams to address administrative requirements and operational needs. Support office infrastructure, facilities, and workplace management activities. Ensure administrative processes are efficient, cost-effective, and aligned with company policies. 
 Vendor Management Act as the primary point of contact for vendors related to administrative and facility requirements. Coordinate with vendors for services including office facilities, housekeeping, security, transport, maintenance, supplies, and other administrative requirements. Monitor vendor performance and ensure services are delivered as per agreed standards. Coordinate vendor contracts, renewals, invoices, and payment-related documentation. Work closely with Finance and internal stakeholders for timely processing of vendor payments. Negotiate and manage vendor relationships to ensure quality service and cost efficiency. Maintain proper records of vendor agreements, invoices, and service-related documentation.

Monitor office supplies and administrative inventory. Support workplace safety, security, and general office administration. Handle administrative escalations and ensure timely resolution of operational issues. 
 Key Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of HR Operations and Employee Lifecycle Management Hands-on experience in Payroll Management Experience working with HRIS and HRMS platforms Strong understanding of attendance and leave management systems Vendor and stakeholder management experience Good knowledge of HR documentation and operational processes Strong analytical and reporting skills Excellent communication and interpersonal skills High attention to detail and accuracy Strong problem-solving and coordination abilities Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders 
 Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or a relevant specialization will be preferred. 
 Experience 5-8 years of relevant experience in: HR Operations Payroll Management HRIS/HRMS Administration Employee Lifecycle Management Administration and Facilities Management Vendor Management 
 Experience in managing both HR Operations and Administration will be highly preferred. 
 What We Are Looking For 
 We are looking for a proactive HR Operations professional who can take ownership of critical HR systems and processes while also effectively managing administrative operations and external vendors. 
 The successful candidate will play an important role in ensuring smooth employee operations, accurate payroll and HR data management, efficient HRMS processes, and seamless day-to-day administrative support across the organization.

description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Job Description HR & Payroll Manager Position: HR & Payroll Manager
 Industry: Construction / Contracting / Waterproofing
 Department: Human Resources & Administration
 Location: Mumbai / Site & Head Office
 Reporting To: Director / Management Job Summary We are looking for an experienced and responsible HR & Payroll Manager to manage end-to-end human resource functions and payroll operations for our construction contracting business. The role will be responsible for managing office and site manpower, attendance, payroll, recruitment, employee records, labour compliance, statutory deductions, and employee-related administration . The ideal candidate should have good knowledge of construction-site manpower management, labour laws, payroll processing, PF, ESIC, PT, TDS, Bonus, Gratuity, and other applicable statutory compliances . Key Responsibilities 1. HR & Manpower Management Manage the complete employee lifecycle from recruitment to separation . Maintain employee master data, personnel files, joining documents and KYC records. Coordinate recruitment of site engineers, supervisors, skilled workers, helpers, operators, and office staff . Plan manpower requirements in coordination with Project Managers and Site Engineers. Coordinate deployment and transfer of manpower between different project sites. Maintain records of employee attendance, leave, overtime and absenteeism. Develop and maintain company HR policies, procedures and employee guidelines. Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters and workplace issues. 2. Payroll Management Manage monthly payroll processing for office and site employees. Verify attendance, overtime, leave and wage inputs before payroll processing. Prepare salary sheets, wage sheets, payslips and bank payment statements. Calculate deductions such as PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, TDS, advances, loans and other recoveries . Ensure timely processing of monthly salaries and wages. Maintain payroll records and employee salary history. Coordinate with the Accounts Department for salary disbursement and accounting entries. Reconcile payroll data with attendance and bank payment records. 3. Labour & Statutory Compliance Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements . Manage monthly compliance relating to: Provident Fund (PF) ESIC Professional Tax (PT) Labour Welfare Fund (where applicable) TDS on salaries Bonus Gratuity Minimum wages Payment of wages Working hours and overtime Leave and other applicable labour requirements Maintain statutory registers and records. Coordinate with consultants, government authorities and statutory agencies whenever required. Ensure timely filing of returns and payment of statutory dues. Monitor changes in applicable labour regulations and advise management accordingly. 4. Construction Site HR Management Maintain proper manpower records for all active project sites. Coordinate site attendance and biometric/manual muster records . Verify daily manpower deployment and prepare monthly attendance statements. Coordinate worker onboarding, induction and documentation before deployment. Ensure workers have required identification and statutory documentation. Coordinate with site teams regarding labour availability and productivity. Monitor overtime and additional manpower requirements. Maintain records of skilled, semi-skilled and unskilled workers. Support site management in resolving worker-related issues. 5. Subcontractor & Labour Contractor Management Maintain records of manpower deployed through labour contractors/subcontractors. Verify contractor labour attendance and wage records. Ensure labour contractors comply with applicable statutory requirements. Collect and verify PF, ESIC, wage registers, challans, attendance and other compliance documents from contractors. Coordinate with Accounts for processing subcontractor/labour contractor bills after compliance verification. Monitor manpower deployment against contractual requirements. 6. Recruitment & Employee Onboarding Prepare job descriptions and coordinate recruitment activities. Source candidates through job portals, consultants, references and other channels. Conduct initial screening and coordinate interviews. Prepare offer letters, appointment letters and joining documentation. Conduct employee induction and orientation. Ensure all required documents are collected and properly maintained. 7. Exit & Full & Final Settlement Manage resignation, termination and employee separation processes. Conduct exit interviews where required. Prepare full & final settlement calculations. Coordinate settlement of salary, leave encashment, advances, deductions and other dues. Ensure timely issuance of relieving and experience letters. 8. HR MIS & Reporting Prepare and maintain regular HR reports, including: Employee headcount Site-wise manpower Attendance and absenteeism Overtime Salary and wage summary New joiners Resignations and attrition Labour contractor manpower PF/ESIC compliance Leave records Manpower cost Project-wise manpower cost

**Job Description**
**About the Role**
**We are looking for a highly organized and detail\-oriented Sr. Associate, HR Shared Services to join our team in India. This role is critical in providing prompt, accurate, and consistent HR support to our employees. The ideal candidate will primarily manage the end\-to\-end onboarding process for new hires and efficiently resolve employee inquiries through our ticketing system.**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Employee Onboarding
* Manage the complete pre\-boarding and onboarding lifecycle for new employees in India.
* Ensure timely collection, verification, and processing of all required new hire documentation (e.g., identity proof, education certificates, background check forms).
* Coordinate with internal teams (e.g., IT, Payroll, Facilities) to ensure a seamless Day 1 experience, including system access, equipment setup, and workspace readiness.
* Conduct HR\-related induction and orientation sessions, explaining company policies, benefits, and HR processes.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records in the HRIS (Human Resources Information System).
* HR Ticket Handling and Query Resolution
* Serve as the first point of contact for HR\-related queries from employees, managers, and external partners via the HR Shared Services ticketing system.
* Efficiently manage and resolve a high volume of tickets related to various HR topics, including policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), benefits, and data changes.
* Ensure all tickets are logged, categorized, tracked, and resolved within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Escalate complex or specialized issues to the appropriate HR Centers of Excellence (CoE) or other departments, ensuring a smooth handoff and follow\-up.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of the knowledge base by documenting resolutions and frequently asked questions (FAQs).
* Compliance and Audit Support
* Ensure strict compliance with all local Indian labor laws and company policies during the onboarding and record\-keeping processes.
* Support internal and external HR audits by providing necessary documentation and data.


**Required**
**Qualifications and Skills**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Experience: 3\-5 years of experience in an HR Shared Services or HR Operations role, preferably with a focus on onboarding in a large\-scale or multi\-state environment in India.
* Knowledge: Solid understanding of core HR processes and Indian statutory compliance related to hiring and employee documentation.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in using an HRIS (e.g., SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, Oracle) and experience with a ticketing system (e.g., ServiceNow, Zendesk).


**Preferred**
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Proven ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
* A strong customer service mindset, with a proactive approach to problem\-solving.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment.

title: HR Operations & Executive Assistant
description:
KOCHI, KL, India
   

  

 Apply Now!
   

  

**Location:** 
 On\-site / Hybrid (Kochi, Kerala)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 2–4 years in an IT consulting, software services, or staffing agency environment
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Role Overview**
 Infintor Solutions is seeking a proactive, highly organized
 **HR Operations \& Executive Assistant** 
 to streamline our internal business operations and support executive leadership.
   

  

 In this dual\-capacity role, you will serve as the administrative backbone of our team—owning human resources administration, talent acquisition, timesheet coordination, employee engagement, basic financial coordination, and high\-level executive assistance for Management. You will act as the primary point of contact for internal team queries, establishing clear operational boundaries and enabling leadership to focus on driving core company growth.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* HR Operations, Recruitment \& Talent Coordination
* Talent Acquisition \& Pipeline Management: Lead recruitment drives for internal requirements and staff augmentation clients. Source candidates, screen resumes, schedule interviews, and maintain an active talent pool for fast deployment.
* Leave \& Timesheet Management: Own the leave management system and enforce strict weekly/monthly timesheet submission schedules across all business units.
* Onboarding \& Offboarding Logistics: Oversee end\-to\-end onboarding for new hires and interns—including offer letters, non\-disclosure agreements (NDAs), system asset allocation, and orientation schedules.
* Internship Mentoring \& Training Coordination: Structure internship mentoring plans, schedule technical training sessions with senior team leads, and monitor intern progress.
* Employee Engagement \& Culture: Plan and execute internal employee engagement activities, team outings, festival celebrations, and wellness initiatives to build a strong workplace culture.
* Personnel Records Maintenance: Maintain digital personnel files, employment contracts, internship completion certificates, and company policy manuals.
* Executive Assistance \& Operational Coordination
* Task Planning \& Follow\-Up Coordination: Assist management in tracking cross\-departmental action items, setting task priorities, and following up with team leads on project/admin deadlines.
* Executive Calendar \& Sales Scheduling: Manage executive calendars, schedule client discovery calls, and resolve meeting conflicts across domestic and international time zones.
* Communication Buffer: Serve as the primary internal buffer—filtering routine operational inquiries from team members and directing them to established standard operating procedures before escalating to leadership.
* Meeting Documentation: Attend key strategy, leadership, and operational review meetings to record action items, assign owners, and track completion deadlines.
* Financial Admin \& Accounts Support
* Invoicing \& Accounts Receivable Support: Draft milestone\-based and time\-and\-materials (T\&M) client invoices based on approved timesheets, maintain billing schedules, and conduct polite, structured follow\-ups on overdue accounts.
* Payroll Input \& CA Coordination: Prepare monthly payroll inputs by the 25th of every month (based on approved timesheets and leave records), coordinate with our external Chartered Accountant (CA) firm, and distribute payslips on payday.
* CA \& Expense Assembly: Collect vendor bills, receipts, and recurring software subscription invoices, categorizing them for monthly handover to our external CA firm.
* Asset \& Facilities Management: Maintain the company hardware asset register (laptops, monitors, mobile devices) and coordinate office facility vendor support.


**Key Qualifications \& Requirements**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration (BBA), Commerce (B.Com), HR, or a related field.
* Experience: 2–4 years of experience in HR operations, talent acquisition, or executive assistance within an IT consulting or staff augmentation agency.
* Core Competencies \& Tool Skills:
+ Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace / MS Office (specifically Google Sheets / Excel for tracking timesheets and invoicing).
+ Hands\-on experience with modern HRMS platforms, leave/timesheet tracking tools, or Odoo modules.
+ Familiarity with recruitment sourcing channels (LinkedIn, job portals) and basic invoicing workflows.

* Soft Skills:
+ Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
+ High level of discretion and integrity when managing sensitive salary, financial, and personal data.
+ Firm, assertive, and professional communication style capable of enforcing timesheet submission deadlines and following up on overdue client invoices independently.

description:

 Ready to rock the future with us? At Hellmann we put our people at the heart of everything we do, because for us, relationship matters. * A more structured, repeatable way of building content and running the platform is in place.

 **HR Executive**

description:
**₹5\-6 LPA \| Green Park, New Delhi \| Full\-time** 




**HR Generalist / HR Manager (Sole Charge)** 




 Shri Paramani Jewels Pvt. Ltd.
 



**About Us** 




 Shri Paramani Jewels is a New Delhi jewellery house with a legacy since 1789, dealing all type of Gold and Silver jewellery, and precious stones. As we grow, we are setting up our first in\-house HR function and looking for someone who wants to build and own it end to end.
 



**The Role** 




 This is a rare opportunity to run the entire HR function for a heritage jewellery business, working directly with the founders. You will be the single point of ownership for everything people related: hiring, payroll, policy, and everything in between, with real autonomy and visibility from day one.
 



**What You'll Own** 



* Employee Relations: Handle workplace disputes and grievances fairly and confidentially, keeping a positive, professional environment across the team.
* Appraisals \& Payroll: Run the monthly salary distribution process and coordinate periodic performance appraisals.
* Recruitment: Manage end to end hiring, from sourcing and screening to interviews and offers, to keep our stores and back office fully staffed.
* Attendance, Leave \& Manpower Planning: Own policies around offs and shift timings, and ensure adequate staffing coverage at every point in time.
* Documentation \& Compliance: Handle the full paperwork lifecycle, including onboarding, NDAs, exits and terminations, leave records, and statutory compliance such as ESIC and PF.



**What We're Looking For** 



* 3 to 6 years of experience as an HR Generalist/Executive, ideally from a retail, trading, manufacturing, or other SME/owner led business (jewellery or luxury retail experience is a strong plus).

title: Finance & HR Manager
description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on, detail\-oriented Finance \& HR Manager to take full ownership of ULQ India finance and general operations as a key individual contributor. This role is responsible for end\-to\-end accounting, statutory and tax compliance, providing financial analysis to support business decision\-making, as well as providing local administrative and HR support. The ideal candidate is a qualified CA with experience in Big 4 and/ or fintech or financial services industries, who is comfortable working independently and partnering with cross\-functional teams.
 



  
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Accounting \& Controllership
 


* Manage end\-to\-end accounting operations including GL, AP, AR, fixed assets, and month\-end/year\-end closures.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of financial books in compliance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS).
* Establish and maintain robust internal financial controls, SOPs, and financial governance processes.
* Support statutory, internal, and tax audits and ensure smooth closure.



  





 2\. Tax Filing \& Compliance
 


* Ensure timely and accurate filing of all statutory returns including GST, TDS, Income Tax, and ROC filings.
* Liaise with external tax consultants and statutory auditors on tax assessments, disputes, and compliance matters.
* Monitor regulatory changes (including RBI guidelines where applicable) and ensure the company remains fully compliant.
* Maintain accurate records of tax payments, TDS, demand payments, and litigations, and reconcile with ITR filings.



  





 3\. Financial Analysis \& Reporting
 


* Prepare and present monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports including P\&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow statements.
* Analyze revenue, cost, margins, opex and business performance trends, providing actionable insights to leadership.



  





 4\. Treasury \& Cash Management
 


* Monitor cash flow, working capital, and liquidity positions to support business operations and growth.
* Oversee bank and vendor reconciliations, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.



  





 5\. Audit
 


* Respond to internal and external audit requests as required, providing accurate and timely information and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to gather and validate information required for audit activities, ensuring requests are addressed within agreed timelines.
* Support the audit process by maintaining appropriate records and responding to follow\-up queries or requests for clarification as needed.



  





 6\. Local HR Support \& General Operations
 


* Provide local support for hiring and onboarding processes (such as interview scheduling, candidate communication, and employment agreement execution) in coordination with Head of HR.
* Maintain employee master records and leave/ attendance data in HiBob following internal guidelines.
* Act as the local point of contact for third\-party payroll vendors to facilitate timely payroll data inputs, tax submissions, and statutory contributions.
* Support local offboarding and exit documentation procedures.
* Handle day\-to\-day office administrative matters, coordinate with external suppliers (facilities, supplies), maintain IT/ office asset registers, and assist with corporate/ statutory filing documentation.



  
 



**Qualifications \& Experience** 




 Education:
 


* Bachelors degree in accounting, finance or other related majors, MBA in Finance is a plus.
* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) is mandatory.



  
 



 Experience:
 


* 4\-7 years of progressive experience in finance, accounting, and tax compliance, with at least 2\-3 years in big 4, fintech, or financial services environment.



  
 



 Technical Skills:
 


* Strong understanding of Ind AS, GST, TDS, Income Tax, and ROC compliance requirements.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel (financial modeling, pivot tables, complex formulas) and experience with ERP/finance software.
* Experience with Zoho Books, or similar accounting software is a plus.



  
 



 Soft Skills:
 


* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to present complex financial information clearly to non\-finance stakeholders.
* High integrity, ownership mindset, and ability to work independently in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet tight deadlines, and build strong cross\-functional relationships.
