title: Senior HR Analyst
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior HR Analyst
About the Role  

  

The People Analyst will be a key member of the Regional People Data \& Analytics team, delivering workforce insights, analytics, and strategic decision support across multiple business units globally. This role combines analytics, data management, reporting, program management, and emerging AI capabilities to enable data\-driven talent decisions across Mastercard.  

  

The ideal candidate is a detail\-oriented problem solver with strong SQL and data modeling expertise, a passion for data quality, and an interest in leveraging Generative AI to improve workforce analytics and business outcomes. This individual will help transform complex people data into actionable insights while driving consistency, scalability, and innovation across reporting and analytics solutions.  

  

Key Responsibilities  

Workforce Analytics \& Reporting  

Serve as the primary point of contact for operational reporting, workforce metrics, and analytics requests from global stakeholders.  

Partner with business leaders to understand underlying business challenges and translate them into actionable analytical solutions.  

Collaborate with the Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A) CoE to support monthly headcount reporting, forecasting, and workforce analysis.  

Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations that provide meaningful workforce insights.  

Data Management \& Quality  

Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of workforce data across systems and reporting solutions.  

Partner with HR Systems, Data Management, and Engineering teams to identify and resolve data quality issues.  

Establish controls and validation processes to improve trust and reliability of workforce metrics.  

Drive data governance standards and ensure compliance with privacy and security requirements for people data.  

Data Modeling \& Analytics Engineering  

Design and maintain scalable analytical data models to support reporting, self\-service analytics, AI use cases, and workforce planning.  

Apply dimensional modeling principles and create efficient data structures for workforce analytics.  

Leverage SQL to query, analyze, validate, and optimize large and complex datasets.  

Collaborate with Data Engineers and Analysts to improve analytical data foundations and reporting capabilities.  

AI \& Innovation  

Explore and leverage Generative AI solutions to improve reporting efficiency, automate insights generation, and enhance workforce analytics.  

Identify opportunities to incorporate AI\-driven capabilities into reporting, analytics, and decision support processes.  

Partner with analytics teams to evaluate emerging technologies and improve the employee analytics experience.  

  

All About You  

Essential Qualifications  

Experience working with organizational, workforce, HR, or people\-related data.  

Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes behind business questions.  

Advanced SQL skills with experience querying, analyzing, troubleshooting, and optimizing large datasets.  

Strong understanding of data modeling concepts, including dimensional modeling, relationships, keys, hierarchies, and analytical data structures.  

Proven ability to improve data quality, data integrity, and reporting accuracy across multiple systems and data sources.  

Advanced Excel experience including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, formulas, conditional formatting, charts, and data analysis.  

Ability to communicate complex analytical findings to non\-technical audiences.  

Experience building scalable reporting solutions, dashboards, and self\-service analytics capabilities.  

Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively across global teams and multiple time zones.  

Ability to work within data governance, privacy, and compliance frameworks.  

Flexible, proactive, and able to adapt to changing business priorities.  

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.  

  

Preferred Qualifications  

Experience with HRIS platforms, preferably Workday.  

Experience managing and analyzing structured and unstructured data using SQL, Python, R, or similar technologies.  

Experience with BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Domo, or similar platforms.  

Familiarity with ETL and data integration tools such as Alteryx, Informatica, or similar technologies.  

Exposure to Generative AI technologies and AI\-powered analytics solutions.  

Experience designing analytical datasets, semantic layers, feature stores, or enterprise reporting models.  

Understanding of data governance, metadata management, and enterprise data quality frameworks.  

Experience influencing stakeholders and driving adoption across large, matrixed organizations.  

Knowledge of workforce planning, talent analytics, organizational effectiveness, or employee experience analytics.**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated success using rapid prototyping to accelerate product\-market fit and customer adoption.

title: HR & Operations Manager
company: Insight Talent Solution | Global Recruiting & Staffing Agency
description:
**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Shift Timing:** 
 6:30 PM – 3:30 AM IST
 



**Experience Required:** 
 4–8 Years
 



**Industry:** 
 IT Staffing / US Staffing / Recruitment
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced and highly organized HR \& Operations Manager who can independently manage HR operations, employee engagement, recruitment, staffing operations, performance management, and day\-to\-day workforce activities.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience working in the IT Staffing / US Staffing industry, managing recruiters and employees, handling recruitment operations, maintaining HR processes, and ensuring smooth coordination between management and staffing teams.
 



 This is a night\-shift role aligned with US business hours, and candidates should be comfortable working from 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**





 Recruitment \& Staffing Operations
 



* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment activities for internal hiring and staffing requirements.
* Handle recruitment for IT Recruiters, US IT Recruiters, Business Development Managers, Account Managers, Sales professionals, and other operational positions.
* Work closely with management and department heads to understand hiring requirements.
* Manage job postings, sourcing, screening, interviews, offer negotiations, and onboarding.
* Monitor recruiter productivity and overall recruitment performance.
* Maintain recruitment pipelines and ensure timely closure of open positions.
* Support US Staffing operations and coordinate with recruiting, sales, account management, and delivery teams.
* Ensure staffing teams follow defined recruitment processes, reporting structures, and performance expectations.



  






 Employee Management
 



* Manage employees throughout the complete employee lifecycle.
* Handle onboarding, orientation, documentation, probation reviews, confirmations, promotions, transfers, and exits.
* Maintain employee attendance, leave records, shift schedules, and HR documentation.
* Monitor employee performance, productivity, discipline, and workplace conduct.
* Coordinate performance reviews and improvement plans with managers.
* Address employee concerns, grievances, workplace issues, and internal conflicts professionally.
* Conduct regular employee engagement and feedback sessions.
* Support managers in improving team productivity, accountability, and retention.



  






 HR Operations
 



* Develop and implement HR policies, SOPs, processes, and internal guidelines.
* Maintain accurate employee records and confidential HR documentation.
* Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, increment letters, warning letters, experience letters, relieving letters, and other HR documentation.
* Manage leave, attendance, holiday calendars, employee databases, and HR reports.
* Coordinate payroll inputs including attendance, leaves, incentives, deductions, and employee changes.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable employment requirements.
* Maintain proper documentation for audits and management reviews.



  






 Operations Management
 



* Oversee daily office and staffing operations during the US shift.
* Coordinate between HR, recruitment, sales, business development, account management, and leadership teams.
* Track daily, weekly, and monthly team performance.
* Ensure employees follow work schedules, reporting processes, productivity expectations, and operational standards.
* Identify operational gaps and implement process improvements.
* Prepare management reports related to recruitment, attendance, employee performance, attrition, hiring, and operations.
* Support management with workforce planning and organizational growth initiatives.
* Ensure smooth communication between India\-based teams and US business operations.



  






 Performance \& Employee Engagement
 



* Establish measurable KPIs and performance standards for employees.
* Conduct regular performance reviews with department managers.
* Track recruiter and staffing team performance against targets.
* Identify underperformance and coordinate Performance Improvement Plans where required.
* Develop employee engagement initiatives to improve retention and workplace culture.
* Organize team activities, recognition programs, celebrations, and employee communication initiatives.
* Build a professional, accountable, and performance\-driven workplace culture.



  






 Required Skills \& Experience
 



* 4\+ years of experience in HR, Recruitment, Operations, or Staffing Management.
* Previous experience in IT Staffing / US Staffing is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of the US Staffing recruitment lifecycle.
* Experience managing recruiters and staffing employees.
* Strong knowledge of recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, and HR operations.
* Experience handling employee grievances and workplace issues.
* Strong leadership and people\-management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Comfortable working with recruitment targets, KPIs, and performance metrics.
* Proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace and HR or recruitment management systems.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee information professionally.
* Experience managing performance, attendance, retention, and employee engagement.
* Ability to work closely with founders, senior management, and department heads.



  





**Shift Requirement**




**Working Hours: 6:30 PM – 3:30 AM IST** 




  





 Candidates must be comfortable working permanently in the
 **US staffing/night shift** 
 .
 



  





**Apply**




 Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn with their updated resume.

PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330\+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.
   

  

 PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode \- hyperlocal e\-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.

 Job Objective: We are looking for HRBP for the Tech organization at PhonePe. The role will develop and execute on the HR strategy for the function by partnering closely with the engineering leadership team.

 Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding:

title: Senior HRBP
description:
Back to jobs
   

  

 Senior HRBP
   

  

 Bangalore, India
   

  

****About Ethos****
 Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three\-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
   

  

****About The Role****
 As an HR Business Partner for India, you'll work closely with the Director of People – APAC to support our Bangalore based teams through a period of rapid growth. You will enable leaders to achieve their business goals through their people \- building the capacity of the organization to attract, develop, and retain talent while ensuring every decision holds up against India's statutory and regulatory framework.
   

  

 This role combines strategic HRBP partnership with hands\-on ownership of India\-specific compliance, employee relations, and operational rigor. You'll be a trusted advisor to business leaders and a steady, empathetic presence for employees, while working closely with Payroll \& Compliance, Talent Acquisition, and Total Rewards to deliver a consistent employee experience.
   

  

****Duties And Responsibilities:****
 Business Partnership
   

  

* Conduct regular cadence meetings with your assigned business unit(s), acting as the primary People point of contact for leaders and employees.
* Provide compensation and leveling guidance to business unit leaders, in partnership with Total Rewards, anchored to India market benchmarks and internal equity.
* Analyze workforce trends and metrics \- attrition, hiring, promotions, engagement \- in partnership with the People Operations team to develop solutions, programs, and policies.
* Drive business unit organizational design and talent strategy to achieve business objectives, including headcount planning and role scoping.


 Employee Relations \& Compliance
   

  

* Manage and resolve complex employee relations issues; conduct thorough, objective, and well\-documented investigations.
* Maintain in\-depth, current knowledge of Indian labor law \- including the Shops and Establishments Act, Payment of Bonus Act, Payment of Gratuity Act, POSH Act, and the New Labour Codes as they come into force \- to reduce legal risk and ensure regulatory compliance across Karnataka and any other state of operation.
* Partner with Payroll \& HR Compliance and external legal counsel as needed on statutory matters, notices, and filings.
* Own or contribute to background verification (BGV) exception handling and RAG\-based risk assessment for your business unit, in line with company policy.
* Provide day\-to\-day performance management guidance to managers \- coaching, counseling, career development, and disciplinary action \- consistent with Indian employment norms and documentation standards.
* Work closely with management and employees to improve working relationships, build morale, and increase productivity and retention.
* Provide HR policy guidance and interpretation, flagging gaps between global policy and India\-specific legal requirements.


 Talent, Training \& Culture
   

  

* Identify training needs for business units and individual coaching needs for people managers; monitor and follow up on training and upskilling objectives.
* Support onboarding and offboarding processes for your business unit, partnering with Onboarding \& Ops on a smooth, compliant employee lifecycle.
* Gather and report on metrics related to retention, promotion, hiring, and diversity for your client group.
* Help build and refine India People Ops systems and processes \- you'll help write a policy when one doesn't yet exist.


****Qualifications And Skills:****
* 8\+ years of experience as an HRBP, with a strong point of view on how HRBPs move a business forward; experience at a fast\-growing technology or insurance company is a plus.
* In\-depth working knowledge of Indian labor law and statutory compliance \- PF, ESI, gratuity, statutory bonus, Karnataka Shops \& Establishments Act, and the New Labour Codes. Prior exposure to a multi\-state India compliance footprint is a strong plus.
* Experience managing complex employee relations cases, including conducting investigations and resolving disputes; experience partnering with Underwriting, Engineering, or another regulated business function is a plus.
* Working knowledge of multiple HR disciplines \- organizational design, learning and development, compensation, HR technology, and data management.
* Exposure to a matrixed or multi\-country People team structure (e.g., partnering across India, Singapore, or the US) is a plus.
* You are an empathetic listener who can build trust quickly and hold it, even in difficult conversations.
* You are data\-driven \- able to back up your recommendations to client groups with solid data and clear reasoning.
* You thrive in a fast\-paced, first\-principles environment and see the ambiguity of a scaling company as an exciting challenge rather than a blocker.
* You are a strong communicator, comfortable representing the People function to senior stakeholders.
* You have a genuine passion for diversity, equity, and inclusion.
* Bachelor's degree required; a postgraduate qualification in HR or a related field is preferred.


 Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.

description:
**About NewSpace Research \& Technologies (NRT)**
 NewSpace Research \& Technologies (NRT) is India’s leading Aerospace \& Defence innovation company developing next\-generation autonomous systems, AI\-driven aerial platforms, and advanced technologies for defence and dual\-use applications.
   

  

 Our teams work at the intersection of engineering, product development, and manufacturing, solving complex real\-world problems with speed, precision, and purpose. Our portfolio includes intelligent uncrewed systems such as Autonomous Swarming Drones, Collaborative Combat Aerial Vehicles (CCAV), Tethered Platforms, High\-Altitude Pseudo Satellites (HAPS), Loitering Munitions, and many more.
   

  

 With 500\+ engineers across R\&D and manufacturing, we collaborate with leading Indian and global Defence \& Aerospace organizations to build the future of autonomous systems.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We’re looking for a hands\-on, strategic HR Business Partner to work closely with leaders across engineering, product, and manufacturing functions — the teams shaping India’s next generation of aerospace and technology systems.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a high\-performance, high\-velocity environment, understands technology and manufacturing cultures, and can translate business goals into people strategies. You’ll partner with leaders to shape the organization’s capability, drive performance, ensure compliance, and enhance the overall employee experience — while staying deeply grounded in day\-to\-day HR execution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Strategic Business Partnering
* Partner with functional heads to align people priorities with business objectives, ensuring workforce readiness and capability for upcoming projects.
* Drive organization design, manpower planning, and succession strategies aligned to growth.
* Use HR analytics and insights to support data\-driven decision\-making around talent and engagement.
* Act as a trusted advisor to leaders on talent performance, structure, and employee relations.
* Talent \& Capability Development
* Work closely with the TA function to ensure timely onboarding of the right talent for each function.
* Own the onboarding and assimilation experience, ensuring new hires have clear 90\-day plans and connect well with their teams.
* Identify key skill gaps and coordinate with L\&D to design upskilling, reskilling, and leadership development interventions.
* Support career progression and internal mobility frameworks.
* Performance \& Rewards
* Lead the performance management cycle – goal setting, continuous feedback, appraisal discussions, and performance improvement plans.
* Partner with the compensation team to drive salary reviews, benchmarking, and rewards programs.
* Support the implementation of variable pay, incentive, and recognition frameworks.
* Ensure internal equity and consistency in compensation and progression decisions.
* Employee Relations \& Engagement
* Foster a culture of openness, inclusion, and performance accountability.
* Lead employee engagement and communication initiatives that enhance morale and retention across sites.
* Manage grievances, employee relations cases, and workplace conflict with fairness and discretion.
* Conduct skip\-level connects, stay interviews, and feedback sessions to identify engagement drivers.
* HR Operations, Payroll \& Compliance
* Partner with HR Operations to ensure timely and accurate payroll inputs, employee records, and documentation.
* Ensure smooth handling of HRIS, attendance, and compliance activities across employment categories (permanent, contract, consultants).
* Work closely with Finance for payroll audits, budget validation, and manpower cost controls.
* Oversee policy implementation, discipline cases, and ensure adherence to all applicable labour laws and new codes.
* Administrative \& Site HR Responsibilities
* Manage on\-ground administrative HR tasks — employee data updates, vendor HR coordination, and HR\-related communication for the BU/site.
* Ensure all HR activities at the business unit or facility level run smoothly — from attendance tracking to compliance checks.
* Support logistics for employee onboarding, travel reimbursements, events, and welfare programs.


**Skills \& Attributes**
* Strong business acumen and understanding of engineering/manufacturing environments.
* Proven ability to balance strategic influence and operational execution.
* Experience driving performance, rewards, and engagement frameworks in a fast\-paced tech setup.
* High ownership, agility, and comfort in managing multiple priorities.
* Excellent interpersonal, analytical, and communication skills.
* Proficiency with HRMS tools, payroll systems, spreadsheets, and HR analytics dashboards.
* Fluency in English; working knowledge of Kannada and/or Hindi is an advantage.


**Experience \& Qualification**
* Master’s degree in Human Resources or Business Management (Engineering background preferred).
* 10–12 years of total HR experience, with a minimum of 8 years in an HRBP role supporting technology, product, or manufacturing functions.
* Experience in deep\-tech, aerospace, or advanced manufacturing organizations is a strong plus.

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
**About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for a dynamic and driven HR Business Partner with strong IT industry exposure to lead our HR function across global geographies, primarily Australia and the USA. This role will also play a key part in spearheading the organization's expansion plans around complete AI Digital Transformation, embedding AI\-first thinking into the employee experience and the HR function itself. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on people leader who combines strong business partnering fundamentals with genuine energy and enthusiasm for employee experience — someone who can lead a team, work confidently across HR tools and systems, and bring visible, high\-impact people initiatives to life. This role demands the grit to work hard, the eloquence to influence stakeholders at every level, and the zeal to build a culture of excellence across a distributed, multi\-country workforce. Candidates who are hands\-on with AI tools will be given strong preference.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* **Business Partnering \& Team Leadership**
* Act as a strategic HR Business Partner to business leaders across Australia and the USA, aligning people strategy with business goals.
* Lead and mentor a team of HR professionals, building capability and driving high standards of delivery.
* Bring strong visibility and presence to the HR function — an active, approachable partner rather than a back office function.
* Demonstrate the drive and resilience to work hard, manage ambiguity, and deliver in a fast\-paced global environment.
* 
* **AI Digital Transformation Leadership**
* Spearhead HR's role in the organization's expansion plans around complete AI Digital Transformation.
* Embed AI\-first thinking into HR processes, employee experience, and ways of working across the team.
* Identify and pilot AI tools that can enhance HR service delivery, analytics, and employee engagement.
* Act as an internal champion for AI adoption, building confidence and capability across the workforce.
* 
* **Employee Experience \& Engagement**
* Design and conduct engaging 'WOW' sessions that create memorable, high\-impact employee experiences.
* Plan and run informal 'Coffee Talks' and similar listening forums to build open, two\-way communication with employees.
* Own the end\-to\-end climate/engagement survey process — design, execution, analysis, and action planning.
* Curate and deliver AI\-focused sessions to build employee awareness and comfort with emerging AI tools and ways of working.
* Champion a culture of excellence, eloquence, and enthusiasm across all employee touchpoints.
* 
* **HR Technology \& Tools**
* Demonstrate hands\-on proficiency across HR tools and platforms (HRIS, engagement, survey, and analytics tools).
* Drive adoption of HR technology and digital ways of working across the team and the broader employee base.
* Leverage data and HR analytics to generate insights that inform people decisions and business conversations.
* 
* **Global \& Compliance Exposure**
* Support HR operations across Australia and the USA, ensuring alignment with local employment practices.
* Exposure to employment laws and HR practices in other countries is a strong plus.
* Partner with global stakeholders to ensure consistency of HR standards while respecting local nuances.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Postgraduate degree/diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* B.Tech/MBA with an excellent academic record from premier institutions (XLRI, TISS, IIMs, etc.) preferred.
* 7 – 10 years of progressive HR experience, with a significant portion in HR Business Partnering roles.
* Experience supporting IT/technology organizations and global/multi\-country teams strongly preferred.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Proven HR Business Partnering experience with strong exposure to the IT/technology industry.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing a team of HR professionals.
* Excellent hands\-on working knowledge of HR tools, platforms, and digital HR technology.
* Prior experience working within an MNC / global, multicultural organization.
* Strong exposure to employee engagement initiatives: climate surveys, engagement forums, and culture\-building programs.
* Comfort designing and facilitating sessions on emerging topics such as AI in the workplace.
* Excellent communication and eloquence — able to influence, present, and engage confidently at all levels.
* High energy, ownership mindset, and the resilience to work hard in a fast\-moving global setup.
* Working knowledge of Australian and/or US employment practices; awareness of other country labour laws is an added advantage.
* Hands\-on experience with AI tools (e.g., generative AI, HR chatbots, AI\-based analytics/automation platforms) is a strong added advantage.

title: People Consultant
description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Gurugram, Haryana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience as an HR Business Partner or HR Generalist providing consultations to the business on performance management, workplace queries, etc.
* Experience in managing multiple stakeholders.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience in HR, people programs, or people related roles.
* Experience with cross\-functional collaboration.
* Experience with coaching and mentoring.
* Excellent investigative and problem solving skills, with the ability to organize and analyze data using Human Resource Information System (HRIS) for reporting.
* Excellent teamwork and organizational skills.


**About The Job**
 People Operations strives to revolutionize human resources the same way that Google has revolutionized search. We are helping to find, grow and keep the remarkable assemblage of talent who are our Googlers. You'll be an advocate of Google's culture and values, partnering with our business leaders to help them build their organizations and make sure all people decisions are based on data. Whether coaching our clients on how to lead their teams, navigating and resolving employee relations issues or managing programs that help develop our Googlers, you are exceptionally focused on putting them first, and being as clear and transparent as possible to help Googlers understand how people decisions get made.
   

  

 People Experience (PX) is the team at Google that delivers hire\-to\-retire experiences for employees. We deliver global Human Resource (HR) processes that are personalized for the applicants. PX teams span Recruiting, Problem\-solving and Planning, HR Operations, Vendor Management, Service Model Excellence, and Employee and Market\-level HR support.
   

  

 In this role, you will work with Google employees, People Partners and other People Operation (POps) teams to provide personalized guidance, support, and solutions on people operations related activities requiring expertise across multiple organizations and specialties. You will ensure that employees experience the best that HR has to offer. title: Cluster Factory HR Manager
description:
About the Company
 



  





 Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited (ABLBL), a part of the Aditya Birla Group, is a leading branded apparel company with a comprehensive portfolio of marquee lifestyle brands.
 



 As of March 31, 2025, the Company operates a retail footprint of over 4\.6 million sq. ft., comprising 3,253 exclusive brand outlets, presence across 38,000\+ multi\-brand outlets, and over 7,000 shop\-in\-shops in department stores across the country.
 



 The Company’s brand portfolio includes India’s most established and trusted names – Louis Philippe, Van Heusen, Allen Solly, and Peter England – each with a legacy of over 25 years.
 



 These brands have consistently delivered sustained growth, driven by a sharp focus on design\-led innovation, category expansion, and operational excellence across product lines spanning formal, casual, and occasion wear.
 



 ABLBL has built a strong presence in the innerwear and athleisure market through Van Heusen Innerwear, which has rapidly scaled its distribution network across India. The Company’s portfolio is further enhanced through strategic partnerships with leading international brands including Simon Carter, American Eagle and Reebok. American Eagle has emerged as one of India’s most preferred premium denim brands, while Reebok – transitioned under the Company’s management in 2022 – has expanded its footprint across multiple channels. Simon Carter continues to strengthen its position in the premium menswear segment through its distinctive design language and curated collections.
 



  





**About the Job Role** 




 The Cluster Factory HR will be responsible for leading and managing the Human Resources function across a cluster of 4\-6 manufacturing units. The role requires strong expertise in Industrial Relations (IR), statutory compliance, labor laws, workforce management, employee engagement, and HR operations to ensure seamless factory operations and a positive employee relations climate.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\.Industrial Relations \& Employee Relations** 



* Drive harmonious industrial relations across all assigned manufacturing units.
* Manage union interactions, wage negotiations, settlements, and grievance handling.
* Support plant leadership in maintaining a positive employee relations environment.
* Handle disciplinary matters, domestic inquiries, and dispute resolution.
* Ensure proactive mitigation of IR risks and compliance with labor regulations.



**2\.Statutory Compliance \& Legal Governance** 



* Ensure 100% compliance with applicable labor laws and statutory requirements.
* Monitor compliance related to Factories Act, Industrial Relations Code, Social Security Code, Contract Labour regulations, Shops \& Establishment Act, and other applicable legislations.
* Coordinate statutory audits and inspections from government authorities.
* Maintain all statutory records, licenses, and documentation across locations.



**3\.HR Operations \& Workforce Management** 



* Oversee end\-to\-end HR operations across the factory cluster.
* Lead manpower planning, employee lifecycle management, attendance, leave administration, and separation processes.
* Drive recruitment and staffing initiatives to ensure timely hiring of plant workforce and critical roles.
* Manage the Talent Acquisition (TA) process in collaboration with business leaders and recruitment teams.
* Facilitate and govern the Performance Management System (PMS) cycle across locations, ensuring quality goal setting, reviews, calibration, and closure.
* Drive Talent Development initiatives, including capability building, succession planning, leadership development, and identification of high\-potential talent.
* Manage and ensure timely completion of Annual Confidential Reports (ACR)/Performance Assessment processes for eligible employee groups.
* Monitor workforce productivity and implement manpower optimization initiatives.
* Track HR metrics and provide actionable insights to management.



**4\.Stakeholder Management** 



* Partner with Factory Heads and business leaders to address people\-related challenges.
* Provide HR guidance and support to plant leadership teams.
* Monitor HR metrics and present insights to management for decision\-making.



**5\.Employee Engagement \& Culture** 



* Drive employee engagement initiatives across factories.
* Promote a safe, inclusive, and performance\-driven work culture.
* Facilitate communication forums and employee welfare programs
 **.**



  





**Qualifications and Experience** 



* Master of Social Work (MSW) from a reputed institution is mandatory.
* Additional certifications in Labor Laws, Industrial Relations, or Compliance will be preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of HR experience in manufacturing organizations.
* Proven experience in managing HR operations across 4\-6 factories simultaneously.
* Strong exposure to Industrial Relations (IR), Union Management, and Labor Law Compliance.
* Experience handling factory workforce, contract labor, and statutory audits.

title: Lead Training Manager
description:
**Lead Training Manager \| Urban Company** 




  





**About the Company**




 Urban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, etc., all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high\-quality, standardized, and reliable service experience. To fulfill this promise, we work closely with our hand\-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.
 



 Urban Company started as UrbanClap in November 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav, and Varun, realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented, and offline. Customers found it challenging to avail quality services conveniently, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several

title: Director, Workforce Management
description:
**About HireRight**
 HireRight is the premier global background screening and workforce solutions provider. We bring clarity and confidence to vetting and hiring decisions through integrated, tailored solutions, driving a higher standard of accuracy in everything we do. Combining in\-house talent, personalized services, and proprietary technology, we ensure the best candidate experience possible. PBSA accredited and based in Nashville, TN, we offer expertise from our regional centers across 200 countries and territories in The Americas, Europe, Asia, and the Middle East. Our commitment to get it right every time, everywhere, makes us the trusted partner of businesses and organizations worldwide.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Director of Workforce Management (WFM) is responsible for leading the organization's workforce planning strategy and execution across forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, and real\-time performance management. This role ensures the right resources are available at the right time to meet business demand, service level commitments, productivity targets, and employee experience objectives.
   

  

 The Director will lead a team of workforce management professionals and leverage advanced analytics, workforce technologies, and operational insights to optimize staffing investments while improving customer and employee outcomes. The role serves as a strategic business partner to operational leaders, finance, HR, and executive stakeholders.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Workforce Forecasting \& Demand Planning**
* Develop and lead enterprise workforce forecasting strategies across short\-, medium\-, and long\-term planning horizons.
* Create accurate volume, workload, and staffing forecasts using historical data, business drivers, growth projections, and predictive analytics.
* Partner with Operations, Finance, and Business Leadership to align workforce plans with strategic objectives and budget requirements.
* Monitor forecast accuracy and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance planning processes.
* Conduct scenario modeling and sensitivity analysis to support business decisions, organizational changes, and growth strategies.


**Workforce Forecasting \& Demand Planning**
* Develop and lead enterprise workforce forecasting strategies across short\-, medium\-, and long\-term planning horizons.
* Create accurate volume, workload, and staffing forecasts using historical data, business drivers, growth projections, and predictive analytics.
* Partner with Operations, Finance, and Business Leadership to align workforce plans with strategic objectives and budget requirements.
* Monitor forecast accuracy and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance planning processes.
* Conduct scenario modeling and sensitivity analysis to support business decisions, organizational changes, and growth strategies.


**Capacity \& Staff Planning**
* Establish workforce capacity models to determine staffing requirements and resource allocation strategies.
* Lead annual, quarterly, monthly and weekly workforce planning cycles.
* Develop hiring plans and staffing recommendations based on forecasted demand, attrition trends, productivity assumptions, and business requirements.
* Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and HR to align recruitment strategies with workforce needs.
* Evaluate operational efficiency opportunities and recommend workforce optimization strategies.


**Scheduling \& Workforce Optimization**
* Oversee development and execution of workforce schedules that balance service delivery goals, productivity targets, and employee preferences.
* Ensure compliance with labor laws, company policies, and contractual obligations.
* Drive scheduling best practices, flexible staffing models, shift optimization, and workforce utilization strategies.
* Evaluate and implement scheduling technologies and automation opportunities.
* Lead initiatives to improve schedule adherence, occupancy, and workforce utilization.


**Real\-Time Management \& Analytics**
* Direct real\-time workforce operations to ensure service levels, response times, productivity, and operational KPIs are achieved.
* Monitor intraday performance and lead decision\-making related to staffing adjustments and contingency planning.
* Establish real\-time analytics capabilities, dashboards, and reporting frameworks.
* Identify trends, risks, and opportunities through operational data analysis.
* Provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior leadership.


**Leadership \& Team Development**
* Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing Workforce Management organization.
* Establish clear goals, performance metrics, and development plans for team members.
* Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, innovation, and customer focus.
* Mentor workforce planning leaders and create succession planning strategies within the WFM function.


**Strategic Partnership \& Governance**
* Serve as the subject matter expert for workforce management across the organization.
* Present workforce strategies, capacity plans, risks, and recommendations to executive leadership.
* Partner with Finance on budgeting, labor cost management, and productivity planning.
* Lead workforce management governance processes, performance reviews, and operational business reviews.
* Drive adoption of workforce management technologies and advanced analytics capabilities.


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations Management, Finance, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Human Resources, or related field required.
* Master's degree preferred.


**Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive workforce management, operations planning, or resource planning experience.
* 5\+ years of leadership experience managing forecasting, staffing, scheduling, and real\-time analytics teams.
* Experience in contact center, shared services, BPO, healthcare operations, retail operations, or other large\-scale workforce environments preferred.
* Demonstrated success leading workforce transformation and optimization initiatives.


**Technical Skills**
* Expertise in workforce management systems (Verint, NICE, Genesys, Calabrio, Aspect, UKG, or similar).
* Strong forecasting and statistical modeling skills.
* Advanced proficiency in workforce analytics, KPI reporting, and dashboard development.
* Experience with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
* Strong Excel and data analysis capabilities.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled forecasting and workforce optimization technologies preferred.

description:
***PLEASE ENSURE THAT YOU READ THE JD BEFORE APPLYING.***




  





**Background** 




 Mezink is a fast\-growing startup helping brands leverage the distribution of creators across social media. We have a bold vision to reimagine the relationship between creators and brands, using data and AI.
 



  





 We are headquartered in Singapore and have operations in more than 10 countries across Asia. You'll end up working on global projects from Day 1 along with a team based in atleast 15 different cities.
 



  





**Job Description** 




 The ideal candidate will work closely with the founders, gaining a front\-row seat to the entire business and contributing to various initiatives and projects across different departments, including sales, operations, growth, and more. This role requires someone who is very comfortable handling multiple things at the same time. There is likely to be frequent weekend work. The job description will change frequently and you'll be expected to learn things very quickly. The intensity will be high and the hours will be long but we can promise an insane learning curve and massive opportunities for growth. This role will not be easy. If you prioritise work\-life balance or are looking for a 9 to 5, this isn't the role for you.
 



  





 We are looking for hustlers who are willing to think out of the box and get stuff done \- without making excuses. If you are looking for a more structured set up to learn \- then this isn't the place. We are focussed on execution \- not coaching. Also, this role requires you to operate from Mezink's office in Bengaluru \- there is no remote option.
 



  





*While compensation is not a constraint for the right candidate, but, if you are looking to optimise cash compensation or are expecting hikes for simply switching,*
***please do not apply***
*.*




  





*If you already have an offer from somewhere and are only shopping around for higher compensation,*
***please do not apply***
*.*




  





*Like most early stage start\-ups, the compensation will be a combination of fixed cash, performance linked bonuses and meaningful equity. Do note that this is*
***NOT A PRODUCT ROLE.***




  





*We are only looking for people who are driven by the desire to learn and to build something spectacular.* 




  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  





 There are really no qualifications for this role \- all we need are people who are smart, diligent and willing to put in the work. We are looking to hire learning machines who can grow along with the organization. We will offer enough opportunities to learn and grow quickly.
 



  





 But the following list of qualifications is generally useful:
 


* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, Economics from a Tier 1 institution
* 1\-2\+ years of relevant experience working in a management/strategy/consulting or in a fast\-paced startup
* Very strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients and team\-members across geographies and cultures
* Willingness to get your hands dirty to solve problems quickly \- we are not looking for managers
* Extreme levels of ownership \- if something needs to be done, you can get it done no matter what



  





 We are always excited to have people who love building products from scratch and are self\-starters, hustlers and curious to learn. If you are passionate about working in a high\-paced startup, with amazing learning, empowerment, and growth potential, we would love to hear from you!

title: Associate Director – Workday HCM Solution & Service delivery
description:
Prudential’s purpose is to be partners for every life and protectors for every future. **Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* **Workday HCM Services Leadership** Own the operating rhythm and service performance of the Workday HCM functional service, leading the team to manage request fulfilment, incident resolution, problem management, maintenance, release readiness, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate should be able to establish clear ownership, service expectations, escalation paths, and performance reporting.
* **Demand Shaping \& Delivery Planning** Partner with Process Owners, COEs, LBUs, and governance leads to clarify demand, assess functional and operational impacts, provide delivery estimates and dependencies, and convert approved priorities into executable delivery and release plans.
* **Functional Solution Integrity \& Oversight** Provide functional leadership across Core HCM modules and the wider Workday HCM portfolio. Review proposed configurations and detailed designs to confirm that solutions are supportable, scalable, standardised, secure, and consistent with enterprise architecture and Workday design principles. Escalate material design decisions to the Solution Architect and relevant governance forums.
* **End\-to\-End Solution Delivery** Lead delivery of Workday HCM enhancements and initiatives from approved demand and detailed design through configuration, testing, deployment, hypercare, and transition to steady\-state support. Ensure delivery remains aligned to agreed scope, design guardrails, priorities, quality standards, and business outcomes.
* **Quality Assurance** Direct and assure the quality of Workday configuration and functional deliverables from the team. Ensure peer review, configuration traceability, design\-to\-build alignment, and completion of required artefacts including configuration workbooks, test evidence, deployment plans, and change records. Own and scale automated testing for myHR — establishing a governed test\-data library and automated regression coverage to reduce manual testing effort and post\-deployment defects, and to improve release readiness and speed.
* **Service Operations \& Issue Resolution** Oversee investigation and resolution of complex Workday issues, coordinating functional, integration, security, data, and technology teams as required. Drive root\-cause analysis, corrective actions, knowledge capture, and preventative improvements for recurring or high\-impact issues.
* **Controls, Risk \& Audit Readiness** Ensure delivery and support activities comply with HR technology governance, security, privacy, risk, change\-management, and audit requirements. Maintain complete and current evidence for approvals, access, testing, deployments, production changes, and operational controls. .
* **Stakeholder \& Partner Management** Align HR and Technology stakeholders on delivery status, service performance, risks, decisions, dependencies, and recovery actions. Manage delivery commitments with internal teams and external partners, challenge constructively when quality or timelines are at risk, and maintain transparent communications.
* **Workday Releases \& Continuous Improvement** Assess Workday releases, product enhancements, and service trends with functional leads and stakeholders. Prioritise relevant opportunities, coordinate release impact assessment and regression testing, and deliver improvements that enhance user experience, process efficiency, resilience, and platform value.
* **AI \& Agentic Capability Enablement** Assess, prioritise and embed Workday AI and agentic capabilities into HCM processes where there is a proven use case and data readiness, layering AI onto a stable, integrated Workday foundation rather than automating for its own sake. Partner with Group People Analytics and Group Technology to ensure use cases sit on trusted, governed data, and support the AI\-enabled HR service delivery model (e.g. AskHR / HRSD) so that agentic actions triage, route and resolve within defined process guardrails and controls.
* **Team Leadership \& Capability Building** Build a cross\-skilled, resilient team by deliberately reducing single\-points\-of\-failure and key\-person dependency across Workday HCM modules — establishing primary/ back\-up coverage, cross\-module rotation, and documented knowledge assets so work can be reallocated flexibly without service disruption. Coach the team to operate as trusted advisors rather than order\-takers — probing the underlying business need, proposing standardised and scalable options, and constructively challenging requests that add complexity or deviate from design principles.
* **Performance \& Value Management** Define and monitor delivery and service measures across demand throughput, delivery predictability, defects, incidents, resolution, release quality, stakeholder outcomes, and improvement benefits. Use evidence and lessons learned to focus resources and improve performance
**Qualifications:**

* Overall 15\+ years of experience in HR technology, HRIS delivery, Workday consulting, enterprise applications, or a comparable role, including leadership in complex, multi\-country environments.
* Deep functional knowledge of Workday Core HCM and working expertise across multiple modules such as Absence, Time Tracking, Compensation and Advanced Compensation, Benefits, Recruiting, Talent, Performance, Succession, Learning, and Workforce Planning.
* Experience in leading Workday delivery from requirements and design through configuration, testing, deployment, stabilisation, and transition to support.
* Strong understanding of Workday foundations including organisations, staffing models, job and skills architecture, business processes, security, reporting, data, integrations, and tenant management dependencies.
* Proven service\-delivery capability in leading teams to manage Workday service delivery, across incident, request, problem, change, release, knowledge, and continuous\-improvement practices in an enterprise environment.
* Experience in establishing delivery controls, documentation standards, test governance, release readiness, operational metrics, and audit evidence.
* Ability to translate business priorities and solution designs into executable plans, manage competing demands, and make clear risk\-based recommendations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to lead root\-cause analysis and communicate complex functional and technical matters to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated people leadership, coaching, partner management, and influencing skills across geographies, cultures, and cross\-functional teams.
* Experience in Agile, Kaizen, or other iterative and continuous\-improvement delivery environments.
Practical experience embedding AI, agentic and automation capabilities (e.g. Workday AI features, automated testing) within an enterprise HRIS, including working familiarity with AI governance, data quality, and responsible\-AI controls.  
*

title: HR Generalist
description:
Bengaluru, India  


**About Us**
------------


Ushur delivers the world's first Customer Experience Automation platform built specifically for regulated industries. With guardrails and compliance\-ready infrastructure, Ushur powers vertical AI Agents for healthcare, financial services and insurance.


Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Santa Clara, California, Ushur is backed by Third Point Ventures, Tiger Global, 8VC, Iron Pillar, Aflac Ventures and Pentland Ventures, with a sizeable Fortune 500 customer base. Our Bengaluru office is one of two principal locations and is central to how the company is built and run.


We build AI agents for regulated enterprises, and we run our own operations the same way.


About Ushur l Ushur Platform


**Title:** HR Generalist
  

**Experience:** 2–3 years
  

**Location:** Bengaluru
  

**Work Mode:** Hybrid
  

**Reports to:** Director, People Operations


**About the Role**
------------------


The HR Generalist sits within Ushur's global Operations team — finance, accounting, legal, revenue operations, enablement and HR. The role supports the People function globally, with most day\-to\-day focus on India operations, spanning payroll and statutory administration, benefits, the employee lifecycle, compliance, recruitment and engagement.


You work directly with Operations colleagues in India and the US as a peer on one global team, with shared ownership of company\-wide processes.


Alongside the operational core, the role carries the People function's automation work — identifying where AI can take on repetitive tasks across hiring, onboarding and reporting, and supporting new ways of working as they are adopted across the India team. Ushur is becoming an AI\-native company, and this is where that shows up in People processes.


Operational accuracy comes first: payroll correct and filings on time. The Director, People Operations reviews work carrying statutory or financial risk, with independent ownership building through the first few cycles.


Three things distinguish this role. You work across the whole India People function rather than a slice of it, at a point when most people are still administering parts of it. You work on a question few practitioners at any level get near: how AI is used responsibly in decisions about people, in a business built for regulated industries. And you sit in a global Operations function, not a local support desk.


**AI\-Native Operations**
-------------------------


Automation is core to the Operations team's mandate, and the standard is straightforward: where a process can be run by a workflow, it should be, and a person's time should go to the parts requiring judgment. Dedicated time is allocated to this, with access to Ushur's own platform. In practice, that means:


* Finding repetitive tasks in People processes and automating them.
* Using AI to help with screening, scheduling, checks and reporting — with a person always making the final call on anything that affects an individual.
* Helping new joiners get comfortable with these tools from the start.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


### **Payroll and statutory compliance**


* Run the monthly India payroll cycle — inputs, validation, and post\-payroll reconciliation — working with Finance and Director, People Operations.
* Prepare termination pay inputs and full and final settlements, including notice, leave encashment and recovery calculations, for review before release.
* Support periodic salary structure and labour code updates led by the Director, People Operations.
* Support statutory compliance across PF, EPFO, NPS and professional tax, and act as the first point of contact for employee queries on tax regimes, declarations and payslips.
* Maintain accurate employee records, leave data and reporting in the HRIS.

### **Benefits and vendor management**


* Administer the India benefits programme, including group medical insurance, OPD, meal cards and wellness initiatives.
* Manage benefits vendors: onboarding and offboarding of employees, claims escalations, invoice processing with Finance, quarterly reviews and annual renewals.
* Gather market and cost data to support annual renewals and vendor evaluations.

### **Employee lifecycle**


* Run onboarding end\-to\-end: pre\-joining documentation, HRIS workflows, induction, systems and access coordination with IT, and 30\-60\-90 plans.
* Run offboarding end\-to\-end: exit formalities, relieving and experience letters, asset and access recovery, benefits removal, final settlement coordination, and exit conversations.
* Issue employment letters and respond to employment and background verification requests.
* Administer the HRIS and improve the workflows within it.

### **Talent acquisition**


* Conduct first\-level screening for candidates against structured rubrics and present evidence\-based recommendations.
* Coordinate interview loops across India and US time zones, and keep candidates informed throughout.
* Administer and improve the applicant tracking system, and maintain hiring data and reporting.

### **Compliance, policy and documentation**


* Provide administrative support to the POSH Internal Committee, including the statutory training cadence, record\-keeping and awareness communication.
* Maintain the India People folder set as the single source of truth for the function.
* Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation and responding to information requests.

### **Employee experience and engagement**


* Translate engagement survey findings into practical actions and track them through to closure.
* Run recognition programmes, milestone celebrations and engagement initiatives for the India office.
* Support all\-hands and internal communication for the India team.
* Partner with workplace and administration colleagues on office operations, and administer operational programmes such as the on\-call roster.

**Qualifications**
------------------


### **Essential**

title: Assistant Manager Human Resources
description:
About the Role
 



 We're looking for a Senior HR Manager who has lived inside a high\-volume retail or QSR environment and knows what it takes to keep dozens of stores fully staffed, well\-trained and motivated. This is a hands\-on, build\-and\-scale role, not a maintenance one. You'll own the full people lifecycle for our frontline and store\-management teams across three cities, and you'll be the person who makes sure our headcount keeps pace with our store rollout without sacrificing quality of hire.
 



 You'll partner directly with the MD, cluster managers and the training function, and you'll bring the systems, discipline and energy needed to run HR at scale across a distributed network.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



**Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning** 



* Own high\-volume recruitment for store crew, shift leads and store managers across all three cities, building a pipeline that stays ahead of the store\-opening calendar.
* Build and maintain a sourcing engine (referrals, hyperlocal channels, institutes, gig platforms) that fills frontline roles fast and at the right cost\-per\-hire.
* Forecast manpower needs against the expansion plan and new\-store launch timelines.



**Retention \& Engagement** 



* Tackle frontline attrition head\-on — diagnose root causes, design interventions, and bring measurable improvement to retention and tenure.
* Run engagement, recognition and feedback mechanisms suited to a young, distributed, shift\-based workforce.



**Performance, Training \& Development** 



* Partner with the Head of Training to ensure every new hire moves through structured onboarding and sign\-off gates before going live on the floor.
* Drive a clear performance\-management rhythm across stores, including goal\-setting, reviews and career pathing for high performers.



**HR Operations \& Compliance** 



* Own statutory and labour\-law compliance across all locations — Shops \& Establishments, PF, ESI, minimum wages, contract labour and store\-level documentation.
* Standardise HR processes, policies, SOPs and the HRIS so the system scales cleanly as store count grows.
* Manage payroll inputs, attendance discipline, grievance handling and disciplinary processes fairly and consistently.



**Franchise \& Multi\-City Support** 



* Define people standards, hiring frameworks and training expectations that franchise partners adopt to keep service quality consistent network\-wide.
* Act as the central HR point of contact for cluster managers in Chennai, Bangalore and Hyderabad.



 What We're Looking For
 


* 8\+ years in HR, with at least 4 in a senior role within QSR, food \& beverage retail, organised retail or a multi\-outlet chain.
* Proven track record managing high\-volume frontline recruitment and reducing attrition in a shift\-based workforce.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian labour law and multi\-state statutory compliance.
* Experience standing up HR systems and processes in a scaling business — not just running an established one.
* Comfortable operating across multiple cities and stores, with willingness to travel.
* Hands\-on, founder\-mindset operator who can both set strategy and get into the detail.
* Fluency in English and Tamil; conversational Kannada and/or Telugu is a strong plus.
* MBA/PGDM in HR or equivalent preferred.

title: Head of Talent Management
description:
Position Title: Talent Management \& Organizational Effectiveness
 



 Reporting To: Head HR NTBI
 



 Location: Chennai
 



  





**Role Purpose (Why this role exists)** 




 To architect and drive NTBI's integrated talent strategy, ensuring that performance, potential, and culture are not siloed but fused into a cohesive engine that fuels business agility. This role is tasked with moving beyond traditional HR metrics to create a self\-sustaining talent ecosystem that anticipates future skill demands, de\-risks leadership pipelines, and embeds inclusion into the organizational DNA.
 



  





**Core Scope of Accountability** 




**1\. Performance Management \-** 
**From Evaluation to Enablement** 



* Implement the annual performance cycle into a continuous, real\-time feedback culture rather than a once\-a\-year compliance event.
* Drive the Goal Cascade across NTBI, ensuring every individual goal connects vertically to business strategy and horizontally to cross\-functional alignment.
* Implement Quality\-Adjusted Performance metrics... ensuring that output is measured not just by "what" but "how," integrating behavioral competencies and values.
* Lead the VC / Variable Pay calibration process, ensuring objective, fair, and defensible pay\-for\-performance decisions.



  





**2\. Succession \& HiPo Management** 
 \-
 **Building the Leadership Bench** 



* Develop and sustain a robust, data\-driven Succession Pipeline for all critical roles .
* Identify and nurture High\-Potential (HiPo) talent through structured interventions, not just assessments, but targeted developmental rotations, mentoring, and exposure.
* Create a "Ready\-Now" vs. "Future\-Ready" succession dashboard, ensuring the organization never operates with a single point of failure.
* Partner with business heads to de\-risk leadership continuity, especially in high\-impact engineering and R\&D functions.



  





**3\. Learning \& Development (L\&D) \- Future\-Skilling at Scale** 



* Shift L\&D from a "training calendar" to a capability / skills\-led transformation engine, focusing on future\-critical capabilities
* Design a skills taxonomy for NTBI in line with Nissan, mapping current vs. desired skills across the organization and driving targeted upskilling/reskilling interventions.
* Establish measurable L\&D ROI, linking learning completion to business outcomes (productivity, error reduction, innovation output).
* Drive certification partnerships with leading institutes and platforms to build technical and leadership depth.



  





**4\. Career Architecture \- Clarity, Mobility \& Growth** 



* Redesign the career framework, moving away from linear promotions to a multi\-dimensional career lattice that offers lateral moves, cross\-functional exposure, and skills\-based progression.
* Champion Internal Mobility \& IJP as a cultural norm, not an exception, ensuring that employees see growth pathways within NTBI rather than outside.
* Develop clear career pathways for high\-demand roles with transparent competency expectations at each level.



  





**5\. DEI – Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion (Embedded, Not Add\-On)** 



* Shift DEI from a "check\-the\-box" metric to a business imperative—ensuring diversity in pipelines (campus hiring, laterals, leadership succession).
* Drive inclusive leadership by embedding DEI principles into performance assessments, hiring panels, and promotion decisions.
* Establish measurable DEI KPIs, gender parity at leadership levels, representation of underrepresented groups in STEM roles, and equitable pay analytics.
* Partner with Communications to tell authentic DEI stories that strengthen employer branding.



  





**6\. Culture \& Employee Experience \- The Invisible Force** 



* Design and drive Culture Roadmap for NTBI, ensuring values are not posters but lived behaviors.
* Lead the Employee Engagement / Pulse Survey strategy (including GES integration) and, more importantly, close the loop on Action Planning.
* Institutionalize continuous listening mechanisms, stay interviews, exit insights, and AI\-driven sentiment analysis, to proactively address friction points.
* Embed psychological safety and psychological ownership as measurable cultural outcomes.



**7\. Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning \- Strategic Sourcing to Onboarding** 



* Lead
 **end\-to\-end talent acquisition strategy** 
 , from demand forecasting to sourcing, selection, and onboarding, ensuring alignment with business growth and skill requirements.
* Drive
 **workforce planning** 
 in partnership with Finance and BU heads, translating business strategy into a forward\-looking talent demand map (GETs, laterals, leadership hires).
* Design and execute a
 **multi\-channel sourcing strategy** 
 , campus hiring (IITs/NITs/top engineering colleges), lateral hiring, niche skill acquisition (EV, ADAS, AI/ML, software\-defined vehicles), and executive search.
* Own the
 **employer branding** 
 narrative, positioning NTBI as an employer of choice in the automotive and technology ecosystem, both domestically and globally.
* Build a robust
 **intern\-to\-GET pipeline** 
 , ensuring seamless conversion and reducing time\-to\-productivity for fresh talent.
* Establish and track
 **TA metrics** 
 . Cost per Hire, Time to Fill, Quality of Hire, Offer Acceptance Rate, Diversity Sourcing and drive continuous improvement.
* Partner with the C\&B team on
 **competitive benchmarking** 
 to ensure offers are market\-competitive and defensible.
* Ensure a
 **world\-class candidate experience** 
 , from application to onboarding, that reflects NTBI's culture and values.

**Job Description**  


  

The HRIS Specialist \- Oracle HCM Functional Specialist will serve as a functional subject matter expert (SME) for the Oracle Human Resources Management System (HRMS) platform, with primary responsibility for the configuration, optimization, support, and expansion of HR technology capabilities across a multinational operating environment. This role will lead the design, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of Oracle HRMS solutions and act as a key partner to HR, IT, Payroll, and business stakeholders. The ideal candidate brings deep, hands\-on Oracle HRMS expertise and a strong track record supporting global HR processes across Core HR, Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), Compensation, Benefits, Talent Management, and related modules.  


  

**What You Will Do:**  


  

* Serve as the primary functional SME for Oracle Human Resources Management System (HRMS) and provide day\-to\-day support, configuration, enhancement, and optimization across key HR modules.
* Lead system design, configuration, testing, implementation, troubleshooting, and production support activities for Oracle HRMS in a multinational environment.
* Partner with HR, Payroll, IT, and business stakeholders to gather requirements, translate business needs into scalable Oracle HRMS solutions, and recommend best\-practice system designs.
* Support and optimize Oracle HRMS modules, including Core HR, Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), Compensation, Benefits, Talent Management, and related modules.
* Research, configure, and document solutions that address global business requirements, local country requirements, and process standardization opportunities.
* Coordinate and support system upgrades, patches, releases, and enhancements, including impact assessments, test strategy, regression testing, user acceptance testing, and deployment readiness.
* Maintain system configuration, tables, security roles, workflow setup, and related controls to ensure system reliability, usability, and compliance.
* Develop, validate, and support reports, dashboards, and analytics that enable HR decision\-making and improve operational visibility.
* Ensure data integrity through audits, controls, interface monitoring, issue resolution, and process improvements.
* Train and support end users, HR users, and other stakeholders on reporting, system functionality, and process changes.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, improve user experience, and strengthen HR operational effectiveness through Oracle HRMS.

**What You Will Need:**  


  

**Education and Experience**
* BA/BS in MIS, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
* **Significant progressive HRIS experience with strong hands\-on functional expertise in Oracle HRMS, including configuration, enhancements, implementations, testing, and production support.**
* Experience supporting global or multinational HR operations and country\-specific process requirements preferred.
* Experience supporting HR and/or Payroll systems, self\-service platforms, and related integrations preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**
* **Deep functional expertise in** **Oracle HRMS configuration, workflows, security, testing, troubleshooting, system maintenance, upgrades, and release support.**
* Strong knowledge of Oracle HRMS business processes across Core HR, recruiting, compensation, benefits, talent, time and labor, and payroll\-related workflows.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable, sustainable Oracle HRMS solutions with strong attention to process design and user impact.
* Experience supporting system implementations, upgrades, and large\-scale enhancements in a complex business environment.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and data validation skills, with the ability to identify root causes and resolve system and process issues effectively.
* Advanced reporting skills, including the ability to work with large data sets and complex Microsoft Excel functions
* Strong customer\-facing, consulting, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across HR, IT, Payroll, and business teams.
* Working knowledge of data governance, privacy, and control requirements related to HR data.
* Experience in a high\-volume, transactional environment preferred.
* Oracle HRMS reporting, dashboarding, and analytics experience preferred.

  

  

  

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Exceptional problem\-solving skills with a strong desire for data integrity, process definition, and continuous learning.


Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


The ability to navigate and collaborate with employees through personal circumstances with empathy and professionalism.


Ability to diagnose a problem and lead correction efforts through effective communication and execution.


Superior employee experience focus with the ability to manage competing priorities.


Ability to maintain strict confidentiality in all aspects of job responsibilities.

Experience working in an HR shared services organization for an established, multinational company is ideal.

 Champion the organization's values and translate them into tangible employee behaviors and practices.
   

  

 Design and implement culture\-building interventions that strengthen employee engagement and organizational effectiveness.
   

  

 Partner with leaders to enhance culture, team effectiveness, collaboration, and psychological safety.

 Own and manage the organization's grievance redressal framework and mechanisms.

 .

 **New Wage Codes** 
 ,
 **labour laws, employment regulations and statutory requirements** 
 .

 **HR Compliance Calendar**

* Develop supporting
 **SOPs, guidelines and process notes** 
 wherever required.
* Ensure consistent interpretation and implementation of policies across locations and functions.

* Absenteeism
* Performance ratings
* Employee movements
* Hiring and manpower status
* Compliance status
* Employee lifecycle metrics
* Analyse HR data and provide meaningful insights to management.
* Develop periodic reports highlighting trends, gaps and areas requiring management intervention.

* Maintain confidentiality and ensure appropriate handling of sensitive employee information.

* Policy drafting and implementation capability

* Ability to manage multiple priorities

**5\. Educational Qualification**

**Preferred:** 




 Additional qualification/certification in Labour Laws, Industrial Relations, HR Analytics or related areas.

 , preferably with significant exposure to HR Operations, Performance Management and Compliance.

 **manufacturing / pharmaceutical / multi\-location organisation** 
 would be preferred.

 The ideal candidate should be a

 The role requires a combination of
