title: HR Generalist
description:
":" ProCreator is looking for an HR Generalist / People Operations professional to own and drive core HR operations across the employee lifecycle, while helping strengthen people processes, employee experience, policy governance, and hiring coordination.
 This role is ideal for someone who is hands-on, process-oriented, and comfortable managing day-to-day HR operations independently. The person will play a key role in ensuring smooth onboarding, employee record management, attendance and leave administration, payroll inputs, engagement initiatives, policy execution, and exit formalities. Alongside this, the role will also support recruitment governance and collaborate closely with the recruiter and hiring stakeholders to ensure process adherence and business continuity.
 While the role is primarily an individual contributor position, the person may oversee one recruiter and is expected to step into hiring execution when recruitment volumes or business priorities demand it.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1) Core HR Operations 
 Own end-to-end employee lifecycle administration from post-offer handover through onboarding, active employment, and exits
 Manage employee records, letters, workflows, approvals, and documentation through HR systems, especially Zoho People 
 Handle joining formalities including employment documents, NDA, code of conduct, KYC, bank details, background verification coordination, and induction readiness
 Coordinate with internal stakeholders such as IT for asset allocation, ID creation, access setup, RFID cards, and other onboarding requirements
 Administer leave, attendance, holiday calendars, attendance regularizations, special leave creation, and exception handling
 Provide accurate monthly payroll inputs to the Accounts team and support resolution of employee queries related to attendance, leave, payroll inputs, and employee records
 Maintain HR documentation required for audits, compliance, and insurance-related processes
 
 2) People Processes and Employee Experience 
 Drive probation confirmations, salary revision documentation, promotions, role changes, and related employee lifecycle actions
 Act as a reliable first point of contact for employee queries related to HR policies, insurance, documentation, and routine employment matters
 Plan and coordinate employee engagement initiatives including birthdays, work anniversaries, festive celebrations, team activities, culture-building efforts, and internal learning sessions
 Support employee well-being initiatives, feedback surveys, POSH-related coordination, and periodic learning and development facilitation
 Ensure a smooth, professional, and employee-friendly HR experience across key people touchpoints
 
 3) Employee Relations and Governance 
 Support managers on policy interpretation, employee discipline matters, notice period discussions, underperformance cases, and other sensitive people issues, escalating when necessary
 Maintain and update employee handbook, leave policy, code of conduct, and day-to-day HR process documentation
 Help strengthen governance by ensuring HR processes are followed consistently and documentation is maintained accurately
 Own HR workflow updates, template changes, automation requests, and coordination with system partners for issue resolution
 
 4) Recruitment Coordination and Business Support 
 Provide recruitment governance support by coordinating hiring intake, role approvals, interview process adherence, and hiring progress tracking with stakeholders
 Partner with the recruiter and hiring managers on offer approvals, parity checks, onboarding readiness, and seamless handover from recruitment to people operations
 Support hiring execution directly during peak hiring periods or when business needs require additional recruitment bandwidth
 Ensure recruitment ownership is approached with flexibility and collaboration, rather than as a rigidly separated function
 
 

 Requirements Must-Have Skills and Experience 
 45 years of relevant experience in HR operations, people operations, or HR generalist roles 
 Strong hands-on experience managing the employee lifecycle from onboarding to exit
 Working knowledge of HRMS platforms , preferably Zoho People 
 Solid experience in onboarding, HR documentation, leave and attendance management, payroll input coordination, and employee records management 
 Ability to independently handle employee queries and routine people operations matters in a timely and professional manner
 Good understanding of HR policies, process documentation, compliance coordination, and governance practices 
 Experience supporting employee engagement initiatives and people experience programs
 Strong coordination skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally with recruiters, managers, Accounts, IT, and leadership
 Willingness to support recruitment execution when required by business demand
 Strong ownership mindset, attention to detail, process discipline, and comfort working in a fast-paced environment
 
 Preferred Skills / Nice to Have 
 Proficiency in Zoho People and Zoho Recruit for HR operations and recruitment coordination
 Ability to make backend changes, workflow updates, and system-level process improvements in Zoho tools
 Experience creating, streamlining, and scaling HR processes for operational efficiency
 Tech-savvy mindset with interest in AI adoption in HR , including automation, analytics, chatbots, and AI-enabled hiring tools
 Awareness of evolving HR technology trends and the ability to suggest process or system improvements
 Prior experience working in UX/UI, development, branding, creative, or marketing agency environments will be preferred for stronger business and cultural fit
 
 Education 
 Bachelor degree in any discipline
 Relevant work experience and practical HR capability will be valued more than academic specialization
 
 What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days 
 By the end of the first 90 days, success in this role would look like:
 You have taken ownership of day-to-day HR operations and are independently managing core employee lifecycle processes with minimal supervision
 Employee records, onboarding documentation, leave and attendance tracking, and routine HR workflows are well organized and running smoothly in Zoho People 
 Payroll inputs are being shared accurately and on time, with fewer follow-ups or errors
 New joiner onboarding is structured, timely, and well-coordinated across HR, IT, and other stakeholders
 Employee queries are being responded to promptly and professionally, creating a dependable HR support experience
 Key HR documents, templates, and policy/process trackers are updated, easy to access, and better organized than before
 At least a few process improvement opportunities have been identified and implemented across HR operations, workflows, or system usage
 Employee engagement and people experience initiatives are being run consistently with strong coordination and follow-through
 Recruitment governance is running smoothly, with proper coordination between hiring managers, recruiter, and internal stakeholders
 During high hiring periods, you are able to step in and support recruitment execution without losing grip on core HR operations
 You have built trust with employees, managers, the recruiter, and the COO as a reliable owner of people operations
 
 Who You Are 
 Hands-on and dependable, with a strong bias for execution
 Comfortable balancing structure, empathy, and responsiveness in day-to-day HR work
 Process-minded, organized, and able to manage multiple moving parts without losing detail
 Collaborative and practical in approach, with the confidence to work closely with managers and leadership
 Adaptable enough to support both people operations and hiring priorities as needed
 
 

 Benefits This role offers the opportunity to build meaningful impact across people operations in a growing business environment. You will help shape core HR processes, improve employee experience, support managers and teams, and bring structure and consistency to the people function while partnering closely with leadership.
 At ProCreator, were not just offering a job; were providing a platform for you to thrive, grow, and lead. Here what makes us unique: 
 Unmatched Growth Opportunities : 
 Wealth-Building Benefits : ESOPs, Shared Appreciation Rights (SAR), profit-sharing, and referral bonuses to recognize your contributions. 
 Skill Development : Access professional growth funds, learning courses, and mentorship programs tailored to your ambitions. 
 A Work Environment That Inspires: 
 Comfort Redefined: Ergonomic furniture, standing desks, and training for optimal productivity and well-being. 
 Flexibility : We offer the flexibility of working from the office as well as hybrid work arrangements. 
 Health and Wellness Focus

title: HR Manager
description:
About the Role 
 We are looking for a dynamic, people-oriented and proactive HR Manager to lead and strengthen the organisations HR function. The role is primarily focused on recruitment, employee engagement, people management and building a positive workplace culture . The HR Manager will work closely with management and employees to ensure the organisation attracts the right talent, supports employee performance and development, and maintains a healthy and positive work environment. This is a hands-on HR role for someone who enjoys working closely with people, taking ownership of HR activities and contributing directly to the organisations growth. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition 
 Manage the end-to-end recruitment process across different functions and levels. Understand manpower requirements from department heads and management. Source candidates through job portals, professional networks, references and other recruitment channels. Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate discussions. Coordinate interviews and maintain regular communication with candidates. Follow up with selected candidates through the offer and joining process. Maintain recruitment trackers and provide regular updates on hiring status. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of potential candidates for current and future requirements. 
 2. Employee Engagement & Workplace Culture 
 Build positive relationships with employees across different teams. Create a supportive, energetic and employee-friendly work environment. Identify employee concerns and facilitate appropriate discussions with management. Organise employee engagement activities, team interactions and internal initiatives. Encourage open communication and a positive approach to workplace challenges. Contribute towards strengthening employee morale, motivation and team spirit. 
 3. Employee Relations & People Management 
 Act as a point of contact for employees for day-to-day HR-related matters. Support employees and managers in resolving workplace issues professionally and fairly. Maintain effective communication between management and employees. Understand employee needs and provide appropriate HR support. Promote professional behaviour, accountability and teamwork within the organisation. 
 4. Performance & Development 
 Support the implementation and monitoring of employee performance processes. Coordinate performance reviews and maintain relevant records. Work with managers to identify employee development needs. Support training, learning and development initiatives. Encourage continuous improvement and professional growth among employees. 
 5. HR Operations 
 Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation. Support onboarding and induction of new employees. Coordinate attendance, leave and other routine HR processes. Ensure timely completion of HR-related documentation and internal records. Support management in implementing HR policies and processes. Maintain confidentiality of employee and organisational information. 
 6. HR Planning & Management Support 
 Work closely with management on current and future manpower requirements. Provide HR-related insights and updates to management. Identify opportunities to improve employee experience and HR processes. Support organisational initiatives related to people, culture and performance. Take ownership of assigned HR projects and ensure timely execution. 
 Ideal Candidate 
 The ideal candidate will be: A people-oriented and approachable HR professional . Proactive, energetic and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Strong in communication and interpersonal skills. Capable of independently managing recruitment activities. Comfortable interacting with employees at different levels. Positive in approach and able to create a healthy workplace environment. Good at coordinating multiple HR activities simultaneously. Strong in follow-up, execution and maintaining HR records. Business-focused while maintaining an employee-centric approach. Mature and professional in handling confidential and sensitive matters. 
 Preferred Experience & Qualifications 
 4-10 years of relevant HR experience. Graduate/Postgraduate qualification in HR, Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology or a related field . Strong experience in recruitment and talent acquisition. Experience in employee engagement and employee relations. Experience in Tourism, Travel, Hospitality or other service-oriented industries will be an added advantage . Good working knowledge of MS Office/Google Workspace and HR/recruitment tools. 
 Languages 
 Hindi Mandatory Malayalam Preferred Good communication skills in English are expected. 
 Key Skills 
 Recruitment | Talent Acquisition | Employee Engagement | Employee Relations | People Management | Performance Management | HR Operations | Communication | Coordination | Conflict Resolution | Team Building | Culture Building 
 What We Are Looking For 
 We are looking for someone who sees HR not merely as an administrative function, but as a people and business function . The right candidate should be someone who can hire the right people, connect with employees, build positive energy within the organisation and create a workplace where people feel supported, motivated and accountable. 
 If you are an HR professional who enjoys working closely with people and wants to make a meaningful contribution to organisational growth, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: HR Operations Coordinator
description:
**Job Description**
 Join the team behind iconic brands like Huggies®, Kleenex®, Cottonelle®, Scott®, Kotex®, Poise®, Depend®, and Kimberly\-Clark Professional®. At Kimberly\-Clark, it’s all here for you \- innovation, growth, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

 You’re not the person who will settle for just any role. Neither are we. Because we’re out to create Better Care for a Better World, and that takes people who care about making a difference. Here, you’ll bring your HR operations expertise, judgment, and customer focus to help managers and employees navigate HR processes across a global organization. In this role, you’ll help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.
   

  

**About You**
 In this professional role, based in Pune, you’ll support managers and employees by coordinating HR requests and transactions across the employee lifecycle. As an HR Associate, you will help ensure requests are properly authorized, accurately documented, compliant, and progressed through the correct process.
   

  

 You will work closely with HR Operations, specialist teams, and other functions to resolve cases from request to closure. Strong judgment, attention to detail, clear communication, confidentiality, and a customer service mindset are critical to success in this role.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities Include**
* Execute HR and administrative system transactions on behalf of managers, ensuring required approvals and documentation are in place.
* Interpret manager and employee requests, identify the correct HR process, and route transactions or cases appropriately.
* Coordinate with specialist teams including Compensation, Benefits, Talent Acquisition, Mobility, Finance Operations, and IT to resolve requests.
* Review requests for completeness, consistency, and clarity, and proactively seek additional information before processing.
* Manage a high volume of HR cases and follow up with stakeholders until resolution.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and audit\-ready documentation for all transactions completed under delegated authority.
* Safeguard sensitive and confidential employee information and follow applicable data privacy and compliance requirements.
* Identify non\-standard or complex cases and escalate them to the appropriate process owner.
* Identify recurring process gaps, operational risks, and system limitations, and share feedback with process owners.
* Support process improvements and cross\-functional initiatives that enhance manager and employee experience.
* Provide professional and timely customer service to managers, employees, and partner teams.
* Support HR integration and People Solutions activities as required.


 To succeed in this role, you will need the following qualifications:
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* This is a fixed\-term contract lasting 18–24 months, with the shift running from 1:00PM to 10:00PM IST.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 3\-5 years of experience in HR Operations, HR Shared Services, or a similarly process\-driven administrative function.
* Fundamental understanding of HR practices and end\-to\-end employee lifecycle processes.
* Working knowledge of HRIS platforms such as Workday and case management tools such as ServiceNow.
* Strong judgment, problem\-solving ability, and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple cross\-functional requests with consistency, accuracy, and discretion.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to coordinate across teams and levels.
* Understanding of employee data confidentiality, data privacy, compliance, and audit requirements.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in a Global Business Services or HR Shared Services environment.

title: Global HR Compliance Specialist
description:
Job Title
   

  

 Global HR Compliance Specialist
   

  

**Job Description**
 At Vanderlande, our people are the foundation of everything we achieve. As we continue to grow across North America, EMEA and APAC, the complexity of managing the end\-to\-end HR policies, the employee data and the workforce processes across different legal and regulatory environments continues to increase. Ensuring compliance is therefore not only a matter of meeting legal obligations. It is about safeguarding our employees, anchoring the integrity of our HR operations, and creating the confidence that our people practices are fair, consistent and trustworthy wherever we operate.
   

  

 As Global HR Compliance Specialist, you play a pivotal role in making this happen. You are the custodian of the HR compliance framework that underpins our global End\-to\-End HR service delivery. Working at the intersection of HR, Legal, Privacy, HR Technology and Process Management, you translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, practical standards that can be embedded into daily operations. You help ensure that compliance is not an afterthought or a periodic audit exercise, but a natural part of how HR serves employees and managers every day.
   

  

 This role requires a unique combination of analytical rigor, business pragmatism and stakeholder influence. You will identify risks before they become issues, drive accountability across the organization, and help shape a culture where compliance enables better decisions rather than constraining them. In doing so, you will contribute directly to a global HR function that is trusted, resilient and fit for the future.
   

  

 A successful Global HR Compliance Specialist understands that effective compliance is not measured by the absence of findings, but by the presence of strong governance, transparent processes and the confidence that employees, managers and leaders can place in the way HR operates. This is your opportunity to build that foundation on a global scale.
   

  

 As a Global HR Compliance Specialist, you will ensure our HR policies, HR processes and employee data meet the legal, regulatory and internal requirements that apply in the countries across North America, EMEA and APAC. You will build and maintain the global HR compliance framework, monitor how it is applied in daily service delivery, and advise HR stakeholders on what needs to change when regulations or internal standards move.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Compliance Framework Build and maintain the global HR compliance framework, covering employment law obligations, end\-to\-end process adherence, data protection and record keeping. You define the requirement. The Functions own the policies that answer it and the Global Process Owner Hire to Retire owns the process design. The Service Delivery is accountable for the day to day adherence and execution.
* Monitoring and Assurance Design and run a recurring control and testing cycle across global HR end\-to\-end processes and data. Identify gaps, quantify the risk, agree remediation with the respective accountable owners and track it to closure and anchoring.
* Regulatory Watch Track changes in employment legislation, data protection rules and HR reporting obligations in the countries where we operate, where applicable together with global functions such as Comp \& Benefits leaders. Translate the impact into a clear requirement and route it to the right owner.
* Data Privacy and Records Safeguard the lawful handling of employee data across the HR technology landscape, including retention, access and cross border transfer. Act as the HR counterpart to Privacy and Legal.
* Internal and External Audit Act as the single HR point of contact for audits, both internal and external. Coordinate the scope with Internal Audit, prepare the evidence and manage findings through to sign off. Support external audit on HR controls and on payroll data originating from HR.
* Advisory and Reporting Act as the escalation point for complex HR compliance questions, and report compliance status, open risks and remediation progress to HR leadership.


**Day\-to\-Day Activities**
* Set\-up and maintain \& continuous improve the global HR compliance framework.
* Run compliance checks and controls on global HR processes and data.
* Analyse legislative changes and translate them into requirements for the right owner.
* Advise HR colleagues and people leaders on complex compliance and employee data questions.
* Build and maintain compliance documentation, control descriptions and work instructions.
* Coordinate audit requests, gather evidence and follow up on findings.
* Contribute to global HR transformation and integration projects from a compliance perspective.


**Your Profile**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Law, Business Administration, or a related field.
* At least 5 years of experience in HR compliance, employment law, HR governance, or HR operations in an international organisation.
* Proven track record of building a compliance or control framework from scratch, not only running an existing one.
* Working knowledge of employment law principles and data protection legislation, including GDPR, and the ability to work with local counsel on country specifics.
* Demonstrable experience with internal and external audit cycles, from evidence gathering to remediation follow up.
* Experience with Workday or comparable HR systems, and with working in a matrix organisation where you set the requirement but do not own the policy or the process.


**Skills And Competencies**
* Strong analytical and risk assessment skills, with high attention to detail.
* Ability to translate legal and regulatory language into practical, usable process guidance.
* Excellent stakeholder management, able to build credibility with senior HR leaders.


**What do we offer?**
 This position offers a competitive salary range of € 5\.500 to € 6\.700 per month (excluding 8% holiday allowance).
   

  

 On top of your fixed salary you’ll receive the following secondary benefits
   

  

* 40 vacation days (20 statutory days and a flexible budget worth 20 days).
* Flexible working hours.
* A hybrid workplace (40% working from home and 60% in the office).
* A Health \& Wellbeing budget worth €300,\- per calendar year.
* Commuting allowance, including full reimbursement of travel by public transport.
* Working from home allowance.
* Collective pension scheme and discount on additional health insurance.
* On\-site company health centres with a gym, physiotherapists and occupational therapists.
* Vanderlande Academy and training facilities to boost your skills.
* A variety in Vanderlande Network communities and initiatives.
* And a great company restaurant and coffee bar with barista.


**Ready to apply?**
 Not sure if you meet every single qualification? We still encourage you to apply. We know that great candidates come from all kinds of backgrounds. If the role excites you and you align with most of the requirements, we would love to hear from you. Apply now with your resume and a short motivation letter. For more information contact Fleur.van.den.brule@vanderlande.com
   

  

***Diversity \& Inclusion***
*Vanderlande embraces diversity in all its forms. We welcome qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability status.*

* Maintain reporting documentation, data definitions, SOPs, and governance controls.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reducing manual effort and increasing reporting efficiency.

* Accurate and timely HR dashboards and management reports.
* Monthly DQI reporting and remediation tracking.
* Executive HR analytics and workforce insights.
* Automated reporting solutions and process improvements.
* Reporting governance documentation and controls.
* Stakeholder\-ready presentations and commentary.

**Essential Experience**

* Experience in HR Analytics, HR Reporting, HRIS, Business Intelligence, or related analytical roles.
* Strong experience working with HR data and large datasets.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Experience creating dashboards and reports for senior stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience performing data validation, cleansing, reconciliation, and quality assurance.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills

**Desirable Experience**

* Workday reporting experience.
* Power BI development and dashboard creation.
* Knowledge of HR data governance and data quality frameworks.
* Experience with automation and process improvement initiatives.
* Understanding of workforce planning and organisational analytics.

title: Human Resource Executive
description:
**Job Title: Human Resource Executive**
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad, Telangana
   

  

**Company:** 
 Harmony United Medsolutions Pvt. Ltd.
   

  

**About Us**
 Harmony United Medsolutions Pvt. Ltd. (HUMS) is a dynamic and innovative company dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry. We take pride in being a reliable partner in healthcare management. With nine years of experience, we have developed expertise in end\-to\-end services including medical billing, A.R. management, and other essential healthcare functions.
   

  

 We provide our services to Harmony United Psychiatric Care, a US\-based healthcare company. We are committed to excellence, creativity, and continuous growth, and we are looking for a talented HR professional to join our team.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 The
 **HR Executive** 
 will be responsible for managing and supporting various human resources functions, including recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, payroll, benefits, and HR administration.
   

  

 The role will involve working closely with the HR Manager, hiring managers, and other team members to support the organization's HR strategy and objectives. The ideal candidate should have
 **excellent communication skills** 
 , strong interpersonal abilities, and the confidence to interact with
 **US\-based candidates and stakeholders** 
 .
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Assist in the recruitment process, including job postings, resume screening, candidate sourcing, interviews, and coordination with hiring managers
* Conduct and coordinate interviews with US\-based candidates, ensuring a professional and positive candidate experience
* Communicate effectively with US\-based candidates throughout the recruitment and hiring process
* Coordinate interview schedules and follow up with candidates and hiring managers
* Facilitate the onboarding process for new hires, including orientation, documentation, and training coordination
* Manage and maintain HR documentation, employee records, and HR trackers
* Support payroll and benefits administration
* Ensure a smooth, professional, and welcoming experience for new employees
* Support employee relations and address employee queries in a timely and professional manner
* Promote a positive, inclusive, and engaging workplace culture
* Prepare and manage HR documents, including offer letters, employment agreements, employee correspondence, and termination documentation
* Ensure HR policies and procedures are properly communicated and implemented
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and organizational information
* Participate in HR projects and initiatives, including employee engagement programs, diversity and inclusion initiatives, and policy updates
* Provide regular recruitment and HR updates to the HR Manager and relevant stakeholders
* Perform other HR\-related responsibilities as assigned


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Management, Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
* Minimum 3 years of experience in HR or a related field
* Experience working with English\-speaking countries, particularly the US, will be preferred
* Experience conducting US candidate interviews will be an added advantage
* Strong understanding of HR principles, practices, and employment laws
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent interpersonal and relationship\-building skills
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills
* Ability to communicate confidently and professionally with candidates, employees, hiring managers, and international stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail and follow\-up skills
* High level of integrity and confidentiality
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment


 Diversity, Equality, and Inclusion
   

  

 Diversity, equality, and inclusion are fundamental to our success at HUMS. We actively promote diversity across all aspects of our organization, including but not limited to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, disability, and age.
   

  

 We strive to foster an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are embraced and everyone has equal opportunities to grow, contribute, and succeed.

title: Workday Support Specialist - HR Shared Services
description:
The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.


Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross\-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard\-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.


That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.


Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry\-changing realities.


For our business, for clients, and for you


This is a **brief overview** of the position


Workday Support Specialist is responsible for providing Workday support to employees across all entities. The role focuses on resolving ServiceNow tickets, maintaining accurate employee data, processing updates and corrections, and supporting HR processes throughout the employee lifecycle. The specialist works closely with HR Shared Services, HRBPs, Recruiters, Payroll, and Technical teams to ensure efficient service delivery and a positive user experience.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Resolve Workday inquiries through ServiceNow within SLA targets.
* Support employees with Workday questions and transactions via email, teams and ServiceNow tickets.
* Process Workday data updates and corrections.
* Support employee lifecycle processes and maintain accurate data in Workday.
* Collaborate with HR, Payroll, Recruiting, and Technical teams to resolve cases.
* Investigate and troubleshoot Workday related issues.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Experience in HR Operations, HR Shared Services, or HR Systems support.
* Experience with Workday is an advantage.
* Strong problem \- solving and case resolution skills.
* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional HR teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Good organizational and time management skills.
* Willingness to learn and continuously develop Workday knowledge.

JOB DESCRIPTION
 



 Job Title
 



 Assistant Manager – HR (Recruitment)
 



 Department
 



 Human Resources — Recruitment

 Location
 



 E\-29, 3rd Floor, Sector 8, Noida, Uttar Pradesh \- 201301 (in\-office role)

 Full\-time
 



 Working Hours
 



 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM IST, Monday to Saturday
 



 Experience Required
 



 4–6 years in recruitment, with at least 2–3 years in BPO/call\-center bulk or mass hiring
 



 About the Role
 



 We're hiring an Assistant Manager – HR (Recruitment) to independently own end\-to\-end recruitment for a set of vacancies as required— not an HR generalist or HR operations role. This is a pure recruitment ownership position for someone who has run BPO bulk hiring before and can be handed a batch of open seats and be trusted to fill them, on time, without hand\-holding. Key Responsibilities
 



 End\-to\-End Recruitment Ownership
 



 • Independently own full\-cycle recruitment — from requisition intake to offer and joining — for all vacancies assigned.
 



 • Run bulk/mass hiring drives for high\-volume BPO roles (TSR, Sr. TSR, and similar outbound calling positions) to keep calling\-floor seat occupancy at target levels.
 



 • Take ownership of filling every assigned vacancy — this role is accountable for hiring outcomes, not just supporting a hiring pipeline.
 



 • Extend hiring support to other functions (Digital Marketing, SEO/SMO, PPC, Sales/BDM, IT support, corporate roles) as vacancies arise across the group.
 



 Sourcing \& Bulk Hiring Execution
 



 • Plan and run high\-volume sourcing across job portals, social media, referral programs, walk\-in drives, and consultants/vendors.
 



 • Organize and execute walk\-in interview days and hiring drives when volumes require it.
 



 • Track which sourcing channels are yielding quality BPO hires and shift effort accordingly.
 



 Team Support \& Quality Control
 



 • Guide and supervise the day\-to\-day work of Recruiters/Sr. Recruiters working on your assigned vacancies — screening quality, interview scheduling discipline, and candidate experience.
 



 • Act as the first escalation point for sourcing bottlenecks or stuck requisitions before they reach the Manager/Operations Head
 



 • Review candidate screening and shortlisting for accuracy before roles move to final interview rounds. www.tribizindia.com
 



 Stakeholder \& Data Management
 



 • Partner directly with campaign heads, Team Leaders, Managers, and department heads to understand headcount needs and turn them into an active hiring plan.
 



 • Maintain accurate, duplicate\-free candidate trackers and requisition status for all assigned vacancies.
 



 • Prepare and check Letters of Intent, Appointment Letters, and related HR documentation for accuracy before issuance. What Success Looks Like
 



 As a guide for how this role will be evaluated day to day:
 



 Success Indicator
 



 What Good Looks Like
 



 Time\-to\-fill
 



 Assigned vacancies are filled within agreed timelines without compromising candidate quality.
 



 Seat occupancy
 



 Calling\-floor seat occupancy for owned campaigns stays at or near target, with minimal unfilled\-seat downtime.
 



 Pipeline health
 



 A steady, ready pipeline of screened candidates is maintained for recurring/high\-volume roles at all times.
 



 Team output quality
 



 Recruiters/Sr. Recruiters you guide deliver accurate screening and a smooth candidate experience.
 



 Tracker \& documentation accuracy
 



 Candidate trackers, LOIs, Appointment Letters, and requisition status are accurate, complete, and up to date.
 



 Exact targets (e.g. days\-to\-fill, seat\-occupancy levels, hires per month) to be set with HR leadership based on the group's hiring plan and volumes. Requirements
 



 • Bachelor's/Master's degree in HR, Business Management, or a related field.
 



 • 3–6 years of recruitment experience, with at least 2–3 years specifically in BPO/call\-center bulk or mass hiring — this is non\-negotiable for this role.
 



 • A demonstrated track record of independently filling high volumes of outbound\-calling/BPO vacancies, not just assisting a recruitment team.
 



 • This is a recruitment\-focused position — candidates whose background is primarily HR generalist, HR operations, payroll, or compliance without hands\-on bulk\-recruitment ownership will not be the right fit.
 



 • Strong, hands\-on sourcing skills across job portals, social media, referrals, and walk\-in/hiring drives.

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
**ABOUT PLUM** 




 Plum is India's leading employee benefits and health insurance platform, helping companies take better care of their people. We're on a mission to make healthcare accessible, transparent, and delightful, and we're growing fast. As we scale, our People function is central to how we build, retain, and grow our talent.
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




  





 We're looking for a Senior HRBP who is a genuine thought partner, someone who deeply understands people, business, and the nuance between the two. You'll embed with business teams (with a preference for Sales, Marketing, or Customer\-facing functions), navigate the complex human dynamics of a fast\-scaling startup, and help leaders build resilient, high\-performing cultures.
 



 This is not a transactional HR role. We want someone who thinks in systems, listens before advising, and brings both emotional intelligence and business acuity to every conversation.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL DO** 




  




* **Strategic Partnership.** 
 Act as a strategic thought partner to business leaders, helping them navigate org design, team dynamics, and talent decisions.
* **Conflict Resolution.** 
 Handle sensitive and complex employee situations with discretion, empathy, and sound judgment, from performance conversations to team conflict.
* **Stakeholder Relationships.** 
 Build deep relationships across your business unit; understand their goals, pressures, and the human context behind decisions.
* **Manager Enablement.** 
 Coach managers on leadership, feedback, and people practices, enabling them to grow as leaders rather than creating dependency on HR.
* **People Programs.** 
 Drive critical people programs like engagement, retention, and talent reviews with a bias for impact over process.
* **Culture \& EQ.** 
 Spot cultural signals early and bring them to the surface; be the connective tissue between people and leadership.
* **Cross\-functional Collaboration.** 
 Partner with Talent Acquisition, L\&D, and Comp \& Benefits teams to deliver a seamless people experience.



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 



* **Experience.** 
 5\-7 years of HRBP or People Partner experience, ideally in a B2B who has seen the 1\-10 Journey.
* **Conflict Competence.** 
 Demonstrated ability to manage conflict, have difficult conversations, and hold space for complexity without losing composure.
* **Emotional Intelligence.** 
 High EQ, you read rooms well, build trust quickly, and know when to push and when to listen.
* **Business Acumen.** 
 You understand revenue, growth targets, and what it means to operate in a fast\-paced commercial environment.
* **Functional Context.** 
 Exposure to Sales, Marketing, or Customer Success orgs is a strong plus.
* **Academic Background.** 
 Background or training in Psychology, Organizational Behavior, or Human Development is preferred.
* **Builder Mindset.** 
 You're energized by ambiguity and motivated to create, not just run, people processes.



  





**YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF** 




  




* You've been in the room when a startup scaled through chaos and helped the people come out better for it.
* You find yourself naturally curious about why people behave the way they do.
* You can hold a business leader accountable while still being their biggest champion.
* You don't wait for a playbook, you write the playbook.
* You're as comfortable with data and dashboards as you are with a 1:1 that goes emotionally deep.



  





**WHAT PLUM OFFERS** 



* A seat at the table with real influence on how we build our people culture at scale.
* Comprehensive health insurance (of course, we're Plum).
* Flexible hybrid work environment from Bangalore.
* A leadership team that takes people seriously as a competitive advantage.

title: Global People Relations Partner
description:
**Global Lead – Employee Relations:\-**
 Sapiens is looking for a Global Lead – Employee Relations to lead our Global Employee Relations function, based in Bangalore. If you're a seasoned ER professional ready to take your career to the next level with an established, globally successful company, this role could be the right fit for you.
   

  

**What You'll Do:\-**
 The Global Lead – Employee Relations role is a critical position within Sapiens' People Success function, responsible for maintaining a positive and productive work environment and ensuring regulatory compliance reporting to the VP, Global People Success – Regions. The successful candidate will manage and enhance Employee Relations strategies, handle complex employee issues, and develop policies and processes that contribute to our DNA of “Advance the Possible”. This role designs and governs global ER frameworks centrally, partners with local People Success Partners for regional implementation, and acts as a strategic advisor across all geographies.
   

  

* Employee Relations Strategy: Develop and implement strategies to address and resolve employee relations issues, promote a positive workplace culture, and enhance employee engagement and retention.
* Conflict Resolution: Act as a mediator and advisor for complex employee relations issues and disputes, providing guidance and resolution in line with company policies and legal requirements.
* Policy Development: Create, review, and update employee relations policies and procedures to ensure compliance with current employment laws and best practices.
* Data Analysis: Monitor and analyze employee relations metrics and trends, using AI\-powered analytics and reporting tools to identify patterns, predict risk areas, and prepare recommendations for senior management to drive continuous improvement.
* Compliance and Legal: Ensure the company's practices adhere to state and local employment laws and regulations. Partner with legal counsel when necessary to address compliance issues.
* Communication: Foster open lines of communication between employees and management; counsel managers and employees on ER\-related matters; facilitate effective dialogue to address concerns and promote a transparent work environment.
* Training: Develop and deliver training programs for managers and employees on employee relations topics, including conflict resolution, performance management, and harassment prevention — leveraging AI tools to build, personalize, and scale training content.
* Case Management: Oversee the investigation and resolution of employee complaints and grievances, using AI\-enabled case management tools to ensure a fair, thorough, and efficient process.
* Global ER Ownership: Design and own the global ER framework and operating model, establishing Sapiens' India\-based ER function for all geographies. Define global ER policies and practices centrally, enabling local teams to manage regional implementation with appropriate nuance.
* People Success Partnership: Collaborate with country People Success Leaders and local People Success Partners to implement ER frameworks regionally, acting as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert across all geographies, including India, APAC, and globally.
* Shared Services Integration: Partner closely with case managers within the Shared Services team to ensure seamless end\-to\-end ER case management, driving consistency and quality in case resolution outcomes globally.
* AI\-Driven Efficiency: Actively identify and implement opportunities to use AI and automation tools across ER processes — case triage, policy drafting, sentiment/trend analysis, and reporting — to improve speed, consistency, and decision quality.
* Recruitment \& Compliance Support: Participate in recruitment and dismissal processes and govern employee background checks.


**What To Have For This Position**
**Must\-Have Skills:\-**
* Experience required: 10–15 years
* At least 7\+ years of experience in employee relations roles in global companies
* MA in Organizational Psychology, Behavioural Science, or a related field, or MBA/HR
* In\-depth knowledge and experience of employment laws globally, with expertise across India, Europe and North America
* Mandatory — AI Tool Proficiency: Working proficiency with AI tools (e.g., generative AI, AI\-assisted analytics, and case/workflow automation platforms), and comfort using AI to support case management, policy drafting, data analysis, and reporting
* Excellent interpersonal skills
* Exceptional written and verbal communication
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
* Strong problem\-solving ability
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion
* Cultural sensitivity and empathy
* Ability to build trust and rapport with employees at all levels of the organization


**About Sapiens:\-**
 Sapiens International Corporation is a global leader in intelligent insurance software solutions. With Sapiens' robust platform, customer\-driven partnerships, and rich ecosystem, insurers are empowered to future\-proof their organizations with operational excellence in a rapidly changing marketplace. We help insurers harness the power of AI and advanced automation to support core solutions for property and casualty, workers' compensation, and life insurance, including reinsurance, financial \& compliance, data \& analytics, digital, and decision management. Sapiens has a longtime global presence, serving over 600 customers in more than 30 countries with its innovative SaaS offerings. Qualifications

* 3\-5 years of relevant experience in Risk/ Banking Domain

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

Required Skills

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with exceptional attention to detail.

* Experience with reporting and visualization platforms such as Power BI, Sigma, Snowflake and other business intelligence tools are good to have
* Ability to investigate data anomalies, perform root cause analysis, and communicate findings effectively to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong project management, issue management, and organizational skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to build effective partnerships across business, technology, risk, and compliance teams.

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub \- Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: Specialist, Employee Relations India and APAC
description:
Overview:

ROLE AT A GLANCE:  

The Employee Relations Specialist plays an important and increasingly independent role in delivering ER support within their market as part of the local team. Reporting to the Director of Global Employee Relations, this role owns low‑to‑moderate complexity ER cases end‑to‑end, leads investigations with a growing degree of autonomy, and actively contributes to policy, training, and change initiatives within our global ER framework.  

The Specialist helps ensure that employee concerns are addressed thoroughly, fairly, and promptly — with clear and accurate documentation, sound judgment, and consistent application of policies aligned with local labor law and our global standards. It's a hands‑on role that combines solid ER execution with developing advisory capability, and a meaningful contributor to a positive, trusted employee experience across the organization  

HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT:  

Investigations* Lead and own fact‑finding investigations for low‑to‑moderate complexity matters — including document review, preliminary and follow‑up interviews, evidence gathering, and drafting findings summaries — exercising sound judgment throughout.
* Align with the Global Director of Employee Relations before finalizing investigation conclusions or recommendations, ensuring consistency on approach, documentation quality, and risk considerations.
* Contribute meaningfully to more complex investigations by conducting discrete workstreams, coordinating logistics, taking detailed notes, and preparing well‑organized draft summaries
* Apply established investigation protocols consistently and maintain strict confidentiality at every stage.
* Maintain accurate, thorough, and confidential case documentation in HR systems.

  

Policy Guidance \& ER Support* Serve as a reliable go‑to resource for HR and ER policy questions in the market, providing practical guidance grounded in established frameworks and local labor law, and escalating complex or ambiguous matters to the Global Director.
* Apply a solid working knowledge of local employment law and global ER policies to advise employees and managers on standard‑to‑moderate ER matters with confidence.
* Contribute to maintaining and strengthening local SOPs, templates, and ER resources, identifying opportunities for improvement and flagging gaps to the Global Director

  

Grievance \& Conflict Resolution* Independently manage standard‑to‑moderate workplace concerns — including interpersonal conflicts, recurring issues, and situations involving multiple parties — from intake through closure, ensuring timely, fair, and consistent handling.
* Support mediation efforts by preparing materials, coordinating logistics, capturing key notes, and tracking follow‑up actions; escalate formal mediation facilitation to the Global Director as appropriate.
* Maintain thorough, accurate, and confidential case documentation in HR systems, ensuring records meet quality standards

  

Performance Management Support* Provide managers with confident, practical guidance on performance documentation, feedback conversations, and standard‑to‑moderate performance improvement processes, escalating higher‑risk or senior‑level situations to the Global Director.
* Draft well‑structured performance improvement plans (PIPs) and supporting documentation, incorporating knowledge of policy and local requirements, for Global Director review and alignment before issuance.
* Identify when performance situations carry elevated risk and proactively loop in the Global Director early in the process

  

Change Management Support* Take ownership of assigned ER workstreams within organizational change efforts, including drafting employee and manager communications, coordinating logistics, and tracking employee questions and concerns.
* Proactively surface and escalate employee concerns raised during change efforts, ensuring they are assessed and routed to the right partners, including the Global Director where needed

  

Corrective Action Support* Guide managers through standard‑to‑moderate corrective action processes with confidence, ensuring decisions are grounded in policy, consistent with precedent, and appropriately documented.
* Draft corrective action documentation — including written warnings and performance improvement plans — with attention to accuracy, policy alignment, and local legal requirements, for Global Director review prior to issuance.
* Maintain meticulous documentation and records for all corrective action cases, ensuring proper storage and confidentiality.

  

Training \& Education* Contribute to the design and delivery of ER training by developing materials, coordinating logistics, and managing follow‑up communications.
* Facilitate portions of ER training sessions — including policy education and manager guidance topics — with coaching and oversight from the Global Director.
* Actively help build ER knowledge and awareness across the India market through consistent engagement with HRBPs and proactive communication on ER topics.

  

Additional duties as assigned  

TEAM DYNAMICS:  

We’re building our Global Employee Relations team from the ground up, which means you’ll be part of shaping how ER shows up across the company for years to come. This is a truly global effort—supporting employees and leaders in different regions, cultures, and regulatory environments.  

We partner closely with our HR Business Partners, Ethics \& Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure we’re approaching situations with consistency, fairness, and a shared commitment to our values. It’s a highly collaborative space where thoughtful problem‑solving and strong relationships really matter. If you enjoy meaningful work that helps create a positive, trusted employee experience, this is a team where you can make a real impact.  

QUALIFICATIONS FOR SUCCESS:  

Education* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Law, Business, Psychology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  

Experience* 4\-6 \+ years of HR or Employee Relations experience, including exposure to case management, investigations, performance management and corrective action.

  

Technical and professional skills* Solid working knowledge of local labor and employment law, with a genuine commitment to continued growth in ER expertise.
* Demonstrated experience leading investigations, including document review, fact‑finding interviews, evidence analysis, and drafting clear, well‑supported case summaries.
* Ability to draft high‑quality, policy‑aligned ER documentation (PIPs, corrective action letters, investigation summaries) that requires minimal rework at senior review.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in local language; working English proficiency is required.
* Proficiency with HRIS and case management tools; able to manage a portfolio of open cases with attention to quality and deadlines.
* High integrity and sound judgment; able to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and care.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; consistent and thorough in documentation practices.
* Empathy and strong listening skills; able to build genuine trust with employees and managers across different situations.
* Solid conflict‑resolution skills; able to navigate emotionally charged or sensitive interpersonal situations with composure and fairness.
* Growth mindset, openness to coaching and feedback, and comfort working effectively in a matrixed, global environment across time zones and cultures

description:

 We are seeking an experienced Principal, Principal HRIS Technical Consultant to lead the administration, optimization, support, and continuous enhancement of our global HR technology ecosystem. **About Us**

Thousands of organizations across more than 200 countries and territories trust ICIMS to find and hire the people who shape their future and drive their business forward. Powered by insights from billions of hiring interactions, continuous AI innovation, and a highly extensible platform, ICIMS helps organizations turn talent acquisition into a competitive advantage. * Ensure data integrity, governance, security, and compliance across HR systems.

* Track, prioritize, and manage support tickets, enhancement requests, and system improvements.

* Collaborate with HR, Talent Management, Compensation, Payroll, Finance, Security, and IT teams.

* Lead cross\-functional HR technology projects from design through deployment.
* Deliver end\-user training, knowledge sharing sessions, user guides, and process documentation.

 Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or related field.

title: Senior Associate Staffing
description:
**Job Description**
 The Supply Partner is responsible for staffing a pod\* of up to 250\-300 people throughout their tenure at Publicis Sapient providing them with great experiences throughout their stay in regards to their utilization, their career and growth aspiration preferences, feedbacks and performances. Staffing Partner proactively offers and nominates the individuals from their Pod across books/account/projects to the right opportunity/role.
   

  

* Pod: Group of people in a specific geography and potentially possessing similar skill set.


 Staffing partner owns the pod and is responsible to staff them to the right opportunity/role throughout their tenure at Publicis Sapient keeping in mind their individual career aspirations, business requirements and utilization.
   

  

**Your Impact OR Responsibilities:**
**Pod Management**
* Deploys a pod of capacity 250\-300 people to the right opportunity/role throughout their tenure at Publicis Sapient keeping in mind the individual career aspirations, business requirements and utilization.
* Provides nominations and guidance for filling open needs\- either directly in the system or in collaboration with the respective Capacity Partners.
* Maintains the data accuracy and continuity of context (history of roles, feedbacks, performance, etc.), roll off dates, competencies, primary capabilities, resumes, time\-cards, Supervisor Assignment, travel readiness (Visa process with GPM) for the Pod.
* Provides visibility about skills and availability to the business/delivery organization with respect to pod people.
* Holds meaningful discussions/ difficult conversations with pod people with respect to individual career aspirations, business requirements and utilization.
* Reaches out to business/delivery/account leadership directly, if additional clarity on roles/skills is needed.
* Proactively offers and nominates people from the pod to respective Capacity Partners and provides alternatives to improve utilization.
* Ensures billable utilization meets the target set for the assigned
* Pod/individual and geography.
* Actively facilitates the on\-boarding of New Hires in their pod
* Provides input on growth and development options in collaboration with the supervisors, People Strategists, Learning Strategists etc. to ensure continuous development of skills of individuals in the Pod
* Supports the supervisors and people strategists in the Performance Management process and the related outcomes (feedback processes, assessment, promotion readiness, PIP etc.)
* Be the point of contact for all individuals in their pod for any concerns and issues regarding utilization, deployment and growth aspirations throughout their association with the pod.
* Cooperates /supports /escalates to People Strategist on all people issues outside of staffing focus such as Leave of absence, accidents, harassment, etc.

* Informs and supports the capacity planning issues and resolutions
* People Operations and Quality \- Analyze and provide early visibility into roll\-offs/supply
* Keep abreast of overall pod strategic and tactical staffing and skill needs by analyzing the ongoing Staffing operation, i.e. utilization, open needs reports etc.

* Proactively work on Travel readiness (India) and support VISA processes in collaboration with GPM
* Keeps the quality check with respect to staffing right people on the right places, based on business, client and individual feedback.

* Minimum 5\+ years of experience in bench management and staffing.
* Preferred MBA in HR
* Strong expertise in excel.
* Good understanding of bench deployment.

**Benefits of Working Here:**

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
**Job Description – Chief Financial Officer (CFO)**

**Organization:** VITS Kamats Hospitality Group  
**Location:** Corporate Office – Mumbai

**Role Overview**

VITS Kamats Hospitality Group is looking for an experienced, strategic, and result\-oriented **Chief Financial Officer (CFO)** to lead the organization’s overall financial strategy, governance, financial planning, risk management, and business performance.

The CFO will be responsible for driving **financial sustainability, profitability, cash flow optimization, compliance, and strategic decision\-making** across the corporate office and multiple hotel units.

The role will work closely with the **Managing Director, Promoters, Senior Management, Operations, Projects, HR, Legal, Purchase, and other business functions** to support business growth, expansion, new hotel projects, and long\-term organizational objectives.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**

**1\. Financial Strategy \& Leadership**

* Develop and lead the organization’s overall financial strategy in alignment with business objectives
* Provide strategic financial insights and recommendations to the Promoters and Senior Management
* Drive long\-term financial planning, profitability, growth, and financial sustainability
* Evaluate business performance and identify opportunities for revenue enhancement and cost optimization
* Establish financial targets, KPIs, and performance benchmarks across business units
* Support management in evaluating strategic business decisions, investments, and expansion plans

**2\. Financial Planning, Budgeting \& Forecasting**

* Lead the annual budgeting and business planning process across corporate and hotel units
* Develop financial forecasts, business projections, and scenario\-based financial models
* Monitor actual performance against budgets and forecasts and recommend corrective actions
* Evaluate financial feasibility of new hotels, projects, leases, management contracts, and other business opportunities
* Develop financial models for expansion, capital expenditure, and new business initiatives
* Provide periodic financial performance reviews to Senior Management

**3\. Corporate Finance \& Financial Operations**

* Oversee the overall finance and accounting functions of the organization
* Ensure accurate and timely preparation of financial statements, MIS, P\&L, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and management reports
* Strengthen financial systems, processes, controls, and reporting structures across all units
* Ensure effective revenue accounting, credit control, collections, procurement controls, expense management, and inventory controls
* Ensure proper accounting practices and financial reporting in accordance with applicable accounting standards, including Ind AS
* Drive standardization of finance processes and reporting across all hotel properties

**4\. Cash Flow \& Working Capital Management**

* Provide strategic oversight of organizational cash flow and working capital management
* Develop and monitor short\-term and long\-term cash flow projections
* Optimize receivables, payables, inventory, and working capital cycles
* Monitor fund requirements across corporate and hotel units
* Establish appropriate controls over cash, banking, collections, and payments
* Maintain strong relationships with banks and financial institutions
* Evaluate and manage funding requirements for business operations and expansion

**5\. Banking, Funding \& Financial Institutions**

* Manage relationships with banks, financial institutions, lenders, and other financial stakeholders
* Evaluate and negotiate working capital facilities, loans, credit lines, and other financial arrangements
* Monitor interest costs, borrowing structures, repayment schedules, and financing arrangements
* Support the organization in raising funds for expansion and new projects where required
* Ensure timely submission of financial information and documentation to lenders and financial institutions
* Optimize the organization’s overall financing structure

**6\. Business Expansion \& Investment Evaluation**

* Provide financial leadership for new hotel projects, acquisitions, leases, management contracts, and strategic investments
* Conduct financial feasibility studies and ROI analysis for proposed projects
* Review project budgets, capital expenditure, operating projections, and funding requirements
* Assess financial risks and returns associated with new business opportunities
* Support Senior Management in investment and expansion decisions
* Monitor financial performance of new projects from development through stabilization

**7\. Compliance, Governance \& Risk Management**

* Ensure compliance with GST, TDS, Income Tax, PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, LWF, Companies Act, and other applicable statutory requirements
* Ensure timely filing of statutory and regulatory returns
* Establish and strengthen financial governance and internal control systems
* Identify and mitigate financial, operational, tax, and business risks
* Ensure adherence to internal financial policies, SOPs, and delegated authority frameworks
* Maintain appropriate financial controls across corporate and hotel operations
* Work closely with legal and professional advisors on financial and regulatory matters

**8\. Audit \& Financial Controls**

* Oversee internal, statutory, tax, and other financial audits
* Coordinate with auditors and ensure timely closure of audit observations
* Strengthen internal audit mechanisms and financial control systems
* Ensure accuracy, transparency, and integrity of financial information
* Identify control gaps and implement appropriate corrective measures
* Establish effective risk management and fraud prevention controls

**9\. Hospitality Finance \& Property Performance**

* Monitor financial performance across all hotel properties and business units
* Review hotel\-level revenue, GOP, departmental profitability, operating costs, and key financial indicators
* Monitor food cost, beverage cost, manpower cost, room cost, utility expenses, and other operating expenses
* Drive cost optimization and profitability improvement initiatives across properties
* Review hotel budgets and monthly financial performance with Unit Heads and Operations
* Ensure implementation of financial SOPs and controls across all hotels
* Provide financial support for hotel pre\-openings and new property transitions

**10\. MIS, Analytics \& Management Reporting**

* Establish effective financial MIS and reporting systems for Senior Management
* Develop dashboards and reports covering revenue, profitability, cash flow, working capital, cost, and business performance
* Provide actionable financial insights to support management decision\-making
* Analyze business trends, variances, risks, and opportunities
* Ensure timely and accurate financial reporting across all business units

**11\. Team Leadership \& Organizational Development**

* Lead and mentor the corporate finance and accounts function
* Build a strong, accountable, and performance\-driven finance team
* Establish clear roles, responsibilities, KPIs, and reporting structures
* Develop finance talent and succession plans across the organization
* Conduct periodic performance reviews of finance teams
* Promote a culture of financial discipline, accountability, and continuous improvement

**12\. Cross\-Functional \& Senior Management Coordination**

* Work closely with the Promoters, Managing Director, Senior Management, and Business Heads on financial matters
* Partner with Operations, HR, Legal, Purchase, Projects, Sales, and other functions to improve business performance
* Provide financial inputs for strategic and operational decisions
* Support management in negotiations involving vendors, landlords, lenders, business partners, and other stakeholders
* Ensure alignment between financial objectives and operational priorities

**Key Skills \& Competencies Required**

* Strong experience in **corporate finance and hospitality finance**
* Proven expertise in financial strategy, budgeting, forecasting, and business planning
* Strong knowledge of cash flow and working capital management
* Excellent understanding of taxation, statutory compliance, audit, and financial governance
* Strong financial modelling and investment evaluation skills
* Experience in banking, funding, and financial institution management
* Strong understanding of hotel operations and property\-level financial performance
* Excellent analytical, commercial, and strategic decision\-making skills
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
* Strong knowledge of ERP, Tally, hotel accounting systems, MS Excel, and financial reporting tools
* Ability to work effectively in a **multi\-unit, fast\-growing hospitality organization**

**Qualification \& Experience**

* **CA / MBA (Finance) / equivalent professional qualification** preferred
* Extensive experience in **Finance \& Accounts**, preferably within the hospitality, hotel, real estate, or service industry
* Proven experience in handling **multi\-unit / multi\-location financial operations**
* Experience in a senior finance leadership role with responsibility for strategic financial decision\-making
* Strong exposure to business expansion, project finance, budgeting, cash flow, compliance, and financial controls
* Candidates with experience in **hotel groups / hospitality chains / growing organizations** will be preferred

Pay: ₹1,500,000\.00 \- ₹2,200,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

description:

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. OR

* Networks with local organizations (e.g., Hotel Association and peers) to source candidates for current or future openings.

**Assisting in Administering and Educating Employee Benefits**


* Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims; reviews provider reports for accuracy and corrects errors.


* Assists with unemployment claim activity reports.


* Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented, as needed.

  



**Assisting in Managing Employee Development**


* Assists with departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.


* Ensures employees are cross\-trained to support successful daily operations.


* Assists with coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture.


* Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs


* Assists with ensuring departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

  



**Assisting in Maintaining Employee Relations**


* Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (e.g., develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property\-wide meetings).


* Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action.


* Utilizes an “open door” policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner


* Ensures employee issues are referred to the Department Manager for resolution or escalated to the Director of Human Resources/Multi\-Property Director of Human Resources.


* Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.


* Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.

  



**Assisting in Managing Legal and Compliance Practices**


* Assists with ensuring employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.


* Assists with ensuring compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.

description:

 Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Across the Group, our teams turn the signals that clinical trials, safety systems and quality data generate into insight that helps bring safer treatments to patients around the world.
   

  

 The science and analysis that guides our work is demanding. And this is where we excel. What defines us, though, is how we work together.  Whether you are early in your career or bringing decades of experience, we want you to feel valued for what you do and for who you are. If that sounds like the place you have been looking for, we would love to hear from you.

 The Global People Services Associate acts as a support in a central hub for transactional HR activities. The Global People Services Associate provides efficient, consistent support to all employees and managers.

 University Degree, or equivalent experience, preferably in HR or business administration.

 When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.
   

  

 We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.
